gtia.quest.147A54175ED9413E.title: Your First Workbench
gtia.quest.147A54175ED9413E.subtitle: Hand crafting starts here.
gtia.quest.147A54175ED9413E.desc.0: Craft a Crafting Table and keep it in your inventory until the task completes. This is the starting point for hand tools, storage and the first GregTech components.
gtia.quest.147A54175ED9413E.desc.2: Claim the charged HV Prospector as your exploration aid. Use it to search for ore deposits before digging long tunnels; the scanner helps locate resources but does not mine them for you.
gtia.quest.147A54175ED9413E.desc.4: The nearby branches provide building equipment and optional world settings. None of those branches blocks the main progression.
gtia.quest.19DF2EC1E5BB67FE.title: Plant for the Future
gtia.quest.19DF2EC1E5BB67FE.subtitle: Grow tomorrow's resources today.
gtia.quest.19DF2EC1E5BB67FE.desc.0: Collect a Rubber Sapling and Sugar Cane. Plant both near your workshop and keep a renewable supply growing.
gtia.quest.19DF2EC1E5BB67FE.desc.2: Rubber trees will support resin and rubber production later, while Sugar Cane supplies paper. The Bone Meal reward helps establish your farm; Sugar Cane growth still depends on the available growing conditions.
gtia.quest.02CCA65BFEC1A8C1.title: A Stack of Stone
gtia.quest.02CCA65BFEC1A8C1.subtitle: One stack for the first workshop.
gtia.quest.02CCA65BFEC1A8C1.desc.0: Gather 64 Cobblestone. Keep the full stack in your inventory for detection; it will not be consumed.
gtia.quest.02CCA65BFEC1A8C1.desc.2: Stone supplies your first furnace and basic building blocks. Gather extra sand and clay while exploring, because the Coke Oven will need them later.
gtia.quest.022919E7FDBA0A44.title: Fire Up the Furnace
gtia.quest.022919E7FDBA0A44.subtitle: Turn raw resources into useful materials.
gtia.quest.022919E7FDBA0A44.desc.0: Craft a Furnace from Cobblestone. Use it to turn raw materials into the first usable metals and to fire the bricks needed for your Coke Oven.
gtia.quest.022919E7FDBA0A44.desc.2: The reward provides eight vanilla Blast Furnaces for faster smelting of compatible ores. These are different from the GregTech Primitive Blast Furnace used to make steel.
gtia.quest.6B586DEF6A83F004.title: Carry and Store More
gtia.quest.6B586DEF6A83F004.subtitle: A backpack and storage for your supplies.
gtia.quest.6B586DEF6A83F004.desc.0: Craft a basic Sophisticated Backpack, a Sophisticated Barrel and a Sophisticated Chest. Any wood variant of those storage blocks is accepted; the backpack does not need to be empty or unused.
gtia.quest.6B586DEF6A83F004.desc.2: The reward provides a larger backpack and a set of upgrades for mining, feeding, storage and crafting. Install and configure the upgrades in the backpack interface.
gtia.quest.6B586DEF6A83F004.desc.4: Configure the Void Upgrade carefully before enabling it so that it only discards items you intend to lose. This storage branch is optional.
gtia.quest.4717F1E89DEA5262.title: Fuel for the Workshop
gtia.quest.4717F1E89DEA5262.subtitle: Find Coal and keep your furnaces running.
gtia.quest.4717F1E89DEA5262.desc.0: Mine a GregTech coal deposit and collect Raw Coal. Use your Prospector to help find a deposit, then mine the ore with your pickaxe.
gtia.quest.4717F1E89DEA5262.desc.2: Coal keeps the early furnaces running and becomes Coke in a Coke Oven. Claim the Coal Block supply to support your first smelting batches.
gtia.quest.367AFA23E2694F7F.title: The Nexus Structure Terminal
gtia.quest.367AFA23E2694F7F.subtitle: A building aid for Nexus multiblocks.
gtia.quest.367AFA23E2694F7F.desc.0: Claim the Nexus Structure Terminal from GregTech Nexus Addon. Use it as a building aid for supported multiblock structures.
gtia.quest.367AFA23E2694F7F.desc.2: The terminal helps with structure placement and inspection; you still need the required blocks and a valid machine structure. Read its tooltip and controls before using it on your workshop.
gtia.quest.5AB14981CED18306.title: The GregTech Terminal
gtia.quest.5AB14981CED18306.subtitle: A companion for GregTech structures.
gtia.quest.5AB14981CED18306.desc.0: Claim the GregTech Terminal and use its available applications to inspect GregTech systems. It is a useful companion as you start building multiblocks.
gtia.quest.5AB14981CED18306.desc.2: Before assembling a machine, inspect the controller in the recipe browser and check its structure preview. A controller alone is not a complete multiblock.
gtia.quest.1579E463F7A8F104.title: Wrought Iron
gtia.quest.1579E463F7A8F104.subtitle: A useful refinement of your first Iron.
gtia.quest.1579E463F7A8F104.desc.0: Produce a Wrought Iron Ingot. The early route smelts Iron Nuggets into Wrought Iron Nuggets, then combines nine nuggets into an ingot.
gtia.quest.1579E463F7A8F104.desc.2: Check the recipe browser for the exact route available in this instance. Wrought Iron becomes useful for steel production and other recipes later.
gtia.quest.05ED48B8EAD12485.title: The First Metals
gtia.quest.05ED48B8EAD12485.subtitle: Iron, Copper and Tin begin the factory.
gtia.quest.05ED48B8EAD12485.desc.0: Obtain one Iron Ingot, one Copper Ingot and one Tin Ingot. Smelt the corresponding raw ores or use another available recipe shown in the recipe browser.
gtia.quest.05ED48B8EAD12485.desc.2: Iron is the basis of your first tools. Copper and Tin lead to Bronze, the main construction material of the Steam tier.
gtia.quest.05ED48B8EAD12485.desc.4: Claim the metal supply and keep some of each ingot for tools and hand crafting.
gtia.quest.5ACCF4B9A48CCFFB.title: A Wider Mineral Collection
gtia.quest.5ACCF4B9A48CCFFB.subtitle: Explore more deposits at your own pace.
gtia.quest.5ACCF4B9A48CCFFB.desc.0: Collect a Diamond and ingots of Lead, Silver, Gold and Nickel as you explore more deposits. The task requires one of each; these resources are useful for later recipes.
gtia.quest.5ACCF4B9A48CCFFB.desc.2: This is an optional collection branch. You can finish the Start chapter without finding all five resources, then return when your mining routes expand.
gtia.quest.487911F0F530BC5C.title: Complete the Tool Kit
gtia.quest.487911F0F530BC5C.subtitle: The remaining tools for crafting and machines.
gtia.quest.487911F0F530BC5C.desc.0: Craft an Iron Wire Cutter, Screwdriver, Saw, Knife, Wrench and a Wood Mallet. These complete the basic hand-crafting and machine-configuration kit.
gtia.quest.487911F0F530BC5C.desc.2: Used tools are accepted. The Wrench is needed when crafting the Coke Oven controller, so complete this branch before moving on to that multiblock.
gtia.quest.487911F0F530BC5C.desc.4: Claim the upgraded tools after completing the set. Consult the tooltips for their interaction modes before using them on machines.
gtia.quest.5C7ADFB010AED3FF.title: The First GregTech Tools
gtia.quest.5C7ADFB010AED3FF.subtitle: Hammer, File and Mortar unlock hand processing.
gtia.quest.5C7ADFB010AED3FF.desc.0: Craft an Iron Hammer, Iron File and Iron Mortar. These tools let you make plates, shaped components and metal dusts by hand before machines take over.
gtia.quest.5C7ADFB010AED3FF.desc.2: The tasks accept used tools and do not consume them. Open the recipes and uses of each tool to see the hand-crafting routes available.
gtia.quest.5C7ADFB010AED3FF.desc.4: Claim the improved Hammer, File and Mortar supplied by this chapter. Keep your tools accessible: crafting recipes often use them as reusable ingredients.
gtia.quest.6D37924AE8C4B647.title: Metals into Dust
gtia.quest.6D37924AE8C4B647.subtitle: Prepare metal powders for your first alloys.
gtia.quest.6D37924AE8C4B647.desc.0: Use your Mortar to make Iron Dust and Copper Dust from ingots. Keep one of each dust in your inventory for the tasks.
gtia.quest.6D37924AE8C4B647.desc.2: Dusts can be mixed into alloys. The Bronze Dust reward gives you a starting supply, while the manual Bronze recipe combines Copper Dust and Tin Dust. Check the recipe browser for its proportions.
gtia.quest.44B99A5358D9A1A0.title: Collect the Creosote
gtia.quest.44B99A5358D9A1A0.subtitle: Collect a bucket of the oven's fluid by-product.
gtia.quest.44B99A5358D9A1A0.desc.0: Creosote is the fluid by-product of Coke Oven processing. Collect it through the supported output or hatch and store it in a suitable fluid container.
gtia.quest.44B99A5358D9A1A0.desc.2: Fill a bucket with 1,000 mB of Creosote and keep the Creosote Bucket in your inventory until the task completes. The bucket and fluid are not consumed.
gtia.quest.44B99A5358D9A1A0.desc.4: The main route does not require this collection task. Drain and store Creosote even if you skip the task so that your oven keeps producing Coke.
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.title: Build a Coke Oven
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.subtitle: Your first working GregTech multiblock.
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.desc.0: Craft a Coke Oven controller and at least one Coke Oven Brick casing. The controller recipe uses Iron Plates, Coke Oven Bricks and a Wrench.
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.desc.2: Make Compressed Coke Clay from clay, sand and a Wooden Brick Mold, fire it into Coke Oven Bricks, then craft the casings. Check each recipe in the browser.
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.desc.4: Claim the extra controllers, brick casings and hatches to finish your ovens. Build the hollow 3 x 3 x 3 structure shown by the controller preview, replacing the appropriate casing positions with the controller and any supported hatches.
gtia.quest.0B2619CBDA9424C6.desc.6: Feed Coal into the completed oven to produce Coke and Creosote. Keep the fluid output drained: an oven with a full output cannot continue processing.
gtia.quest.01780714D3006B80.title: Your First Bronze
gtia.quest.01780714D3006B80.subtitle: The foundation of the Steam tier.
gtia.quest.01780714D3006B80.desc.0: Smelt Bronze Dust into a Bronze Ingot. You can use the dust reward from Metals into Dust or mix your own from Copper and Tin.
gtia.quest.01780714D3006B80.desc.2: Bronze is the foundation of the early Steam machines. Keep a stock of ingots and prepare to turn them into plates and machine components.
gtia.quest.64D91166C361698D.title: Ready for Steam
gtia.quest.64D91166C361698D.subtitle: Bronze and Coke open the next chapter.
gtia.quest.64D91166C361698D.desc.0: Produce at least one Coke from your assembled Coke Oven. With Bronze available and the oven working, your workshop is ready to begin the Steam tier.
gtia.quest.64D91166C361698D.desc.2: Claim the supply quests below for Bronze, Coke and a mining tool. These rewards support the next stage without requiring the optional exploration or convenience branches.
gtia.quest.64D91166C361698D.desc.4: Your next project is steam generation: craft a Low-Pressure Solid-Fuel Boiler, supply water and fuel, then connect it to your Steam machines. Keep a heated boiler supplied with water; follow the boiler tooltip and recipe browser when building the system.
gtia.quest.0DE85EE72D07751E.title: Coke for the First Boilers
gtia.quest.0DE85EE72D07751E.subtitle: A starting stock of boiler fuel.
gtia.quest.0DE85EE72D07751E.desc.0: Claim 64 Coke Blocks as a starting fuel supply for the Steam tier.
gtia.quest.0DE85EE72D07751E.desc.2: Keep your Coke Oven running and its Creosote output drained. The reward supports the first machines; sustainable fuel production should come from your workshop.
gtia.quest.64DF9933496200C6.title: Bronze for the First Machines
gtia.quest.64DF9933496200C6.subtitle: A starting stock of the Steam alloy.
gtia.quest.64DF9933496200C6.desc.0: Claim 64 Bronze Ingots to begin crafting your first Steam machine components.
gtia.quest.64DF9933496200C6.desc.2: This is a one-time starting supply. Establish your own Copper, Tin and Bronze production as the factory expands.
gtia.quest.4E13E66E679BAE62.title: A Tool for the Next Stage
gtia.quest.4E13E66E679BAE62.subtitle: Equipment for a growing mining operation.
gtia.quest.4E13E66E679BAE62.desc.0: You have reached the end of Start. Claim the Echoite Vajra supplied by this chapter to help gather resources for your growing factory.
gtia.quest.4E13E66E679BAE62.desc.2: Read its tooltip and interaction modes before mining near your machines or buildings. This is a one-time equipment reward.
gtia.quest.2B745453E6BD37E6.title: Punch a Tree
gtia.quest.2B745453E6BD37E6.subtitle: It is tradition.
gtia.quest.2B745453E6BD37E6.desc.0: Every factory starts with a tree. Sixteen logs give you a workbench, sticks and your first tools, with some left over for a furnace's fuel.
gtia.quest.2B745453E6BD37E6.desc.2: Normal Minecraft tools work fine here; the GregTech ones come a few steps later.
gtia.quest.1628A617DDF4580A.title: Hammer Some Plates
gtia.quest.1628A617DDF4580A.subtitle: GregTech builds with plates.
gtia.quest.1628A617DDF4580A.desc.0: Two Iron Ingots and your &6Hammer&r in the crafting grid make one &6Iron Plate&r. GregTech recipes ask for plates, rods and screws where vanilla would ask for ingots; the Coke Oven controller is your first example.
gtia.quest.1628A617DDF4580A.desc.2: By hand a plate costs two ingots. The Steam Forge Hammer and the Bender make them for less.
gtia.quest.79295A70025E10A9.title: Clay, Sand and a Mold
gtia.quest.79295A70025E10A9.subtitle: What Coke Oven bricks are made of.
gtia.quest.79295A70025E10A9.desc.0: Clay sits under shallow water and in swamps. The &6Wooden Brick Form&r is an Empty Wooden Form shaped with your knife, and it is not used up.
gtia.quest.79295A70025E10A9.desc.2: Three clay, five sand and the form make three &6Compressed Coke Clay&r.
gtia.quest.151B0B520F59BB88.title: Coke Oven Bricks
gtia.quest.151B0B520F59BB88.subtitle: Fired in the furnace.
gtia.quest.151B0B520F59BB88.desc.0: Smelt &6Compressed Coke Clay&r into &6Coke Oven Bricks&r; four of them make one casing block. A Coke Oven takes 25 casings, so keep the furnace busy.
gtia.quest.2A6EC67055E3E9A2.title: Ultimine
gtia.quest.2A6EC67055E3E9A2.subtitle: A whole tree in one swing.
gtia.quest.2A6EC67055E3E9A2.desc.0: Hold the &6Ultimine&r key (grave accent by default) while you break a block and every connected block of the same kind breaks too: a whole tree, a whole ore vein.
gtia.quest.2A6EC67055E3E9A2.desc.2: It breaks up to &e128&r blocks in Journey and &e64&r in Normal, and each block still costs hunger and tool durability.
gtia.quest.1FBA4B5EAD3E4AAE.title: Ore Veins and the Prospector
gtia.quest.1FBA4B5EAD3E4AAE.subtitle: Ores come in veins, not in specks.
gtia.quest.1FBA4B5EAD3E4AAE.desc.0: GregTech ores are placed in large &6veins&r of a few related ores, about one vein for every &e3 x 3&r chunks. Small ore indicators lie on the surface above a vein.
gtia.quest.1FBA4B5EAD3E4AAE.desc.2: The &6Prospector&r shows the ores under you without digging. Mark every vein you find on the map; you will come back for all of them.
gtia.quest.293CBCB33D89DFAC.title: Phase Matrix
gtia.quest.293CBCB33D89DFAC.subtitle: Infinity Ascension's own ore.
gtia.quest.293CBCB33D89DFAC.desc.0: &6Phase Matrix&r veins sit between &eY 40&r and &eY 60&r. Crushed twice, the ore gives Impure Phase Dust, which turns iron into &6Pulsating Alloy&r and, with Red Alloy, into &6Conductive Alloy&r, a wire that loses nothing.
gtia.quest.293CBCB33D89DFAC.desc.2: You will need it in the Steam chapter.
gtia.quest.5BD9B195F39C3C67.title: GregTech Tools 101
gtia.quest.5BD9B195F39C3C67.subtitle: Tools stay in the grid.
gtia.quest.5BD9B195F39C3C67.desc.0: GregTech tools are ingredients: they stay in the crafting grid and lose durability with each use. The &6Hammer&r also crushes ores into Crushed Ore, more than one ingot's worth later on.
gtia.quest.5BD9B195F39C3C67.desc.2: The &6Wrench&r turns and picks up machines, the &6Screwdriver&r changes their modes, the &6Wire Cutter&r connects cables. In Normal worlds GregTech blocks need the right tool to drop.
gtia.quest.79F5B252E2D0A5CC.title: Buckets, Cells and Tanks
gtia.quest.79F5B252E2D0A5CC.subtitle: Every fluid is counted in mB.
gtia.quest.79F5B252E2D0A5CC.desc.0: A bucket holds &e1,000 mB&r. GregTech counts every fluid in millibuckets, and machines take them from tanks, cells and pipes, not from your hands.
gtia.quest.79F5B252E2D0A5CC.desc.2: Creosote burns in a liquid boiler, so keep the oven's output; a Drum or a tank stores it until you need it.
gtia.quest.02F5E3B2D6670E3C.title: Your First Multiblock
gtia.quest.02F5E3B2D6670E3C.subtitle: Read the structure before you build.
gtia.quest.02F5E3B2D6670E3C.desc.0: Press &6R&r on a controller: the first EMI tab shows the structure. Scroll through the layers, and the buttons on the right show one layer at a time or the parts that accept hatches.
gtia.quest.02F5E3B2D6670E3C.desc.2: The &6GregTech Terminal&r and the &6Nexus Structure Terminal&r can place a structure for you. A controller that does not form tells you what is missing when you hover over it. The &6Coke Oven Hatch&r lets pipes take the Coke and Creosote out.
gtia.quest.47E09D20D0332423.title: Before You Boil
gtia.quest.47E09D20D0332423.subtitle: Water first, then fire.
gtia.quest.47E09D20D0332423.desc.0: A boiler heats up slowly and only makes steam once it is hot. Never let it run dry: water poured into an empty, hot boiler makes it &cexplode&r.
gtia.quest.47E09D20D0332423.desc.2: High Pressure boilers are made of steel and give much more steam from the same fuel. The Steam chapter starts with both.
gtia.quest.7B23BB93A5AE5637.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.7B23BB93A5AE5637.subtitle: Journey kit.
gtia.quest.7B23BB93A5AE5637.desc.0: Journey worlds start strong: these are the tools the author picked.
gtia.quest.7E4196105B820CBE.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.7E4196105B820CBE.subtitle: Normal kit.
gtia.quest.7E4196105B820CBE.desc.0: Normal worlds get tools of the age: steel, built to last the Steam Age.
gtia.quest.049A6787856B1B72.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.049A6787856B1B72.subtitle: Journey kit.
gtia.quest.049A6787856B1B72.desc.0: Journey worlds start strong: these are the tools the author picked.
gtia.quest.38F3A101D368347D.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.38F3A101D368347D.subtitle: Normal kit.
gtia.quest.38F3A101D368347D.desc.0: Normal worlds get tools of the age: steel, built to last the Steam Age.
gtia.quest.3E9DCE26606F372C.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.3E9DCE26606F372C.subtitle: Journey kit.
gtia.quest.3E9DCE26606F372C.desc.0: Journey worlds start strong: these are the tools the author picked.
gtia.quest.10FF1800F1CF2FCF.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.10FF1800F1CF2FCF.subtitle: Normal kit.
gtia.quest.10FF1800F1CF2FCF.desc.0: Normal worlds get tools of the age: steel, built to last the Steam Age.
gtia.quest.4409F81060751953.title: Coke for the First Boilers
gtia.quest.4409F81060751953.subtitle: A starting stock of boiler fuel.
gtia.quest.4409F81060751953.desc.0: Claim 16 Coke Blocks to light your first boilers. Keep the Coke Oven running: from here on, fuel is your factory's job.
gtia.quest.2A5BB302DA10045B.title: Bronze for the First Machines
gtia.quest.2A5BB302DA10045B.subtitle: A starting stock of the Steam alloy.
gtia.quest.2A5BB302DA10045B.desc.0: Claim 16 Bronze Ingots for your first steam machine parts, then make your own from Copper and Tin.
gtia.quest.52C9A28AB2CF3FFC.title: A Tool for the Next Stage
gtia.quest.52C9A28AB2CF3FFC.subtitle: Equipment for a growing mining operation.
gtia.quest.52C9A28AB2CF3FFC.desc.0: Claim a Steel Mining Hammer: it breaks a 3 x 3 area at once, a good friend for the long tunnels of the Steam Age.
gtia.quest.777C50D80E2DDE50.title: Steam Age
gtia.quest.777C50D80E2DDE50.subtitle: Ascension I
gtia.quest.777C50D80E2DDE50.desc.0: &6Bronze&r and &6Coke&r got you here. Now water becomes steam, and steam drives your first machines.
gtia.quest.777C50D80E2DDE50.desc.2: Each quest asks for one thing, and each branch starts from what it is made of. The road runs left to right to &6Steel&r and the first circuit. Gears are the stops that matter; diamonds are optional.
gtia.quest.20D6FC1CBD24554B.title: Bronze Age
gtia.quest.20D6FC1CBD24554B.subtitle: Where the Steam age begins.
gtia.quest.20D6FC1CBD24554B.desc.0: You already carry &6Bronze&r from Start, so this completes as soon as you open the chapter. Everything in this tier grows from it.
gtia.quest.3A1582A1094F567F.title: Bronze Pipes
gtia.quest.3A1582A1094F567F.subtitle: Every steam machine starts here.
gtia.quest.3A1582A1094F567F.desc.0: Small Bronze Fluid Pipes carry the steam. Every steam machine in this chapter has a ring of them around its casing.
gtia.quest.484D474834EAB639.title: Bronze Machine Casing
gtia.quest.484D474834EAB639.subtitle: The body of a steam machine.
gtia.quest.484D474834EAB639.desc.0: Bronze plates around bricks. The Macerator, Compressor, Forge Hammer and Extractor are built on this casing.
gtia.quest.4F4CB4AD090721C1.title: Bricked Bronze Casing
gtia.quest.4F4CB4AD090721C1.subtitle: For the machines that burn.
gtia.quest.4F4CB4AD090721C1.desc.0: Bronze plates over three bricks. The Steam Furnace and the Alloy Smelter sit on this casing.
gtia.quest.044777D8A6ACACE5.title: How Steam Machines Work
gtia.quest.044777D8A6ACACE5.subtitle: Three rules worth knowing first.
gtia.quest.044777D8A6ACACE5.desc.0: - Every steam machine has an &dexhaust&r. &cKeep the block in front of it empty&r, or the machine stops after one operation.
gtia.quest.044777D8A6ACACE5.desc.1: - Low-pressure machines take &etwice as long&r as high-pressure ones. High pressure needs &6Steel&r.
gtia.quest.044777D8A6ACACE5.desc.2: - A steam machine refuses any recipe above &e32 EU/t&r (Low Voltage). Those recipes wait for electricity.
gtia.quest.10F6BF82785B0F48.title: Boil Water
gtia.quest.10F6BF82785B0F48.subtitle: Five plates around a furnace.
gtia.quest.10F6BF82785B0F48.desc.0: &eFive&r &6Bronze Plates&r around a &6Furnace&r, over &etwo&r &6Brick&r blocks, turned with a wrench. Give it &6Water&r, burn &6Coal&r or &6Coke&r, and it fills with &6Steam&r.
gtia.quest.10F6BF82785B0F48.desc.2: &cIf it runs dry while hot, let it cool before adding water: water poured into a hot, empty boiler makes it explode.&r
gtia.quest.309831FDDA2D16A3.title: Steam Furnace
gtia.quest.309831FDDA2D16A3.subtitle: Smelting without fuel.
gtia.quest.309831FDDA2D16A3.desc.0: A furnace that runs on the steam you already make, so your &6Coal&r goes to the boiler only.
gtia.quest.0D4E8CC3245E6800.title: Primitive Pump
gtia.quest.0D4E8CC3245E6800.subtitle: Water without buckets.
gtia.quest.0D4E8CC3245E6800.desc.0: A boiler drinks a lot. The &6Primitive Pump&r draws &6Water&r from the world into its &6Pump Hatch&r; pipe it to your boilers. It is built from &6Treated Wood&r, so your Creosote finally has a use.
gtia.quest.0D4E8CC3245E6800.desc.2: &o&7It does not have to stand in water.&r
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.title: More Ways to Make Steam
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.subtitle: Pick by the fuel you have.
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.desc.0: - &6Solid Boiler&r: Coal, Coke, Charcoal. Its Steel version makes more steam.
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.desc.1: - &6Liquid Boiler&r: burns Creosote and lava. Needs &6Glass&r.
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.desc.2: - &6Solar Boiler&r: &ano fuel at all&r, &cnothing at night&r. Needs &6Glass&r.
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.desc.3: - &6Large Bronze Boiler&r: a multiblock, once you have circuits.
gtia.quest.0FF5E90023F5FCFD.desc.5: &aThe Power Generation chapter puts them side by side.&r
gtia.quest.520AD237AC3B724D.title: Alloy Smelter
gtia.quest.520AD237AC3B724D.subtitle: Two inputs, one new metal.
gtia.quest.520AD237AC3B724D.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Furnaces&r and a &6Bronze Brick Casing&r in a ring of small bronze pipes. It melts two ingredients into one, and with a &dmold&r it casts glass and rubber.
gtia.quest.130B22C46670AED8.title: Red Alloy
gtia.quest.130B22C46670AED8.subtitle: Copper and redstone.
gtia.quest.130B22C46670AED8.desc.0: &6Copper&r and &efour&r &6Redstone&r in the Alloy Smelter make &6Red Alloy&r, the conductor of the Ultra Low Voltage tier.
gtia.quest.25B8076FDC395763.title: Red Alloy Wire
gtia.quest.25B8076FDC395763.subtitle: Plate and wire cutter.
gtia.quest.25B8076FDC395763.desc.0: Hammer &6Red Alloy&r into a plate and cut it with the &6Wire Cutter&r. With rubber, after Steel, it becomes a cable.
gtia.quest.30EDF167593F2578.title: Phase Matrix
gtia.quest.30EDF167593F2578.subtitle: Infinity Ascension's own ore.
gtia.quest.30EDF167593F2578.desc.0: &6Phase Matrix&r deposits sit in the stone of the Overworld between &eY 40 and 60&r, marked by indicators on the surface. Your Prospector finds them too.
gtia.quest.363987BE26B78FE4.title: Impure Phase Dust
gtia.quest.363987BE26B78FE4.subtitle: Crushed, then crushed again.
gtia.quest.363987BE26B78FE4.desc.0: The &6Macerator&r crushes the raw matrix; crush the result again for &6Impure Phase Matrix Dust&r. A hand hammer does the second step too.
gtia.quest.363987BE26B78FE4.desc.2: &o&7The recipe viewer shows how much each step yields.&r
gtia.quest.0E0958673BA3B92E.title: Pulsating Alloy
gtia.quest.0E0958673BA3B92E.subtitle: Iron plus phase.
gtia.quest.0E0958673BA3B92E.desc.0: &eOne&r &6Iron Ingot&r and &eone&r &6Impure Phase Matrix Dust&r in the Alloy Smelter make one &6Pulsating Alloy&r.
gtia.quest.0E0958673BA3B92E.desc.2: &o&7An Ender Pearl in place of the dust works too.&r
gtia.quest.236448436A2E4C33.title: Conductive Alloy
gtia.quest.236448436A2E4C33.subtitle: A wire that loses nothing.
gtia.quest.236448436A2E4C33.desc.0: &6Red Alloy&r and &6Pulsating Alloy&r smelt into &etwo&r &6Conductive Alloy&r. Its wire carries Ultra Low Voltage at &e4 amps&r with &ano loss over distance&r.
gtia.quest.3565931FCE2A770E.title: Pistons
gtia.quest.3565931FCE2A770E.subtitle: Every steam machine that moves.
gtia.quest.3565931FCE2A770E.desc.0: The Compressor takes &etwo&r &6Pistons&r, the Macerator &etwo&r, the Forge Hammer &eone&r. Iron works; Bronze and Steel are alternatives for the metal in the middle.
gtia.quest.61C301395A3CD5BF.title: Macerator
gtia.quest.61C301395A3CD5BF.subtitle: Two diamonds well spent.
gtia.quest.61C301395A3CD5BF.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Pistons&r and &etwo&r &6Diamonds&r. It grinds ore, bricks, clay and wood into dust without wearing out your mortar, and it is the first step of the &6Phase Matrix&r.
gtia.quest.45ABA36DDF417F2D.title: Steam Grinder
gtia.quest.45ABA36DDF417F2D.subtitle: A macerator grown into a multiblock.
gtia.quest.45ABA36DDF417F2D.desc.0: Your &6Macerator&r, &etwo&r &6Potin Gears&r and &6Steam Machine Casings&r (&esix&r Bronze Plates around a Brick make two) form the &6Steam Grinder&r. It processes &dseveral items at once&r.
gtia.quest.45ABA36DDF417F2D.desc.2: &o&7Its preview in the recipe viewer gives the casing count.&r
gtia.quest.4717128674ADBA89.title: Compressor
gtia.quest.4717128674ADBA89.subtitle: Squeeze dust into shape.
gtia.quest.4717128674ADBA89.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Pistons&r and a &6Bronze Machine Casing&r. It presses dust into plates, &6Fireclay&r into raw bricks and &enine&r &6Iron Ingots&r into an &6Iron Block&r.
gtia.quest.012E53ECB697D9F3.title: Iron Blocks
gtia.quest.012E53ECB697D9F3.subtitle: Only the Compressor makes them.
gtia.quest.012E53ECB697D9F3.desc.0: &cNine ingots on a crafting table do not make an Iron Block in this pack.&r The Compressor does.
gtia.quest.69D73C20940013E3.title: Anvil
gtia.quest.69D73C20940013E3.subtitle: Five blocks, screws and plates.
gtia.quest.69D73C20940013E3.desc.0: &eFive&r &6Iron Blocks&r, &6Iron Screws&r and &6Iron Plates&r. The Forge Hammer is built around it.
gtia.quest.0BE3526B1728A13F.title: Forge Hammer
gtia.quest.0BE3526B1728A13F.subtitle: Three ingots, two plates.
gtia.quest.0BE3526B1728A13F.desc.0: An &6Anvil&r and a &6Piston&r in bronze pipes. &eThree&r ingots become &etwo&r plates, where the hand hammer needs two ingots for one. It crushes ore too.
gtia.quest.2E1B5CB58E08EB29.title: Wrought Iron Plates
gtia.quest.2E1B5CB58E08EB29.subtitle: The first job for the hammer.
gtia.quest.2E1B5CB58E08EB29.desc.0: &eEight&r &6Wrought Iron Plates&r make an &6Ultra Low Voltage Machine Casing&r, later in this chapter.
gtia.quest.63D808F9077FA81E.title: Fireclay
gtia.quest.63D808F9077FA81E.subtitle: Brick dust and clay dust.
gtia.quest.63D808F9077FA81E.desc.0: Grind &6Bricks&r and &6Clay&r into dust, with the mortar or the Macerator, and mix one of each into &etwo&r &6Fireclay Dust&r.
gtia.quest.7DA696110A273CA4.title: Firebricks
gtia.quest.7DA696110A273CA4.subtitle: Compress, bake, stack.
gtia.quest.7DA696110A273CA4.desc.0: Compress &6Fireclay Dust&r, bake it in a furnace into a &6Firebrick&r, and set &efour&r Firebricks into one &6Firebricks&r block.
gtia.quest.7DA696110A273CA4.desc.2: &aOpen the blast furnace's multiblock preview for the exact count before you start baking.&r
gtia.quest.3713CBE1F33AC0E6.title: Primitive Blast Furnace
gtia.quest.3713CBE1F33AC0E6.subtitle: Your first furnace for Steel.
gtia.quest.3713CBE1F33AC0E6.desc.0: Build the furnace around its controller. It turns &6Iron&r and fuel into &6Steel&r without any steam at all, slowly.
gtia.quest.3713CBE1F33AC0E6.desc.2: &aWrought Iron is much faster than plain Iron:&r with Coke, a Steel ingot takes &e600 ticks&r from Wrought Iron and &e1500&r from Iron.
gtia.quest.707CBC0C69EAFA06.title: Steel
gtia.quest.707CBC0C69EAFA06.subtitle: The metal of the rest of the game.
gtia.quest.707CBC0C69EAFA06.desc.0: Your first &6Steel&r ingot. From here on Steel is in nearly everything: molds, bolts, high-pressure machines, GTNA's large steam machines and the first circuit.
gtia.quest.237E6A27D526CE57.title: High Pressure
gtia.quest.237E6A27D526CE57.subtitle: Steel boilers, faster machines.
gtia.quest.237E6A27D526CE57.desc.0: With &6Steel&r you can build the high-pressure boiler and high-pressure versions of every steam machine. They finish recipes in &ehalf the time&r and burn more steam doing it.
gtia.quest.53C413FEC2C1001C.title: Stronze
gtia.quest.53C413FEC2C1001C.subtitle: Bronze and Steel together.
gtia.quest.53C413FEC2C1001C.desc.0: &6Bronze&r and &6Steel&r in the Alloy Smelter make &6Stronze&r, the metal of GTNA's large steam machines.
gtia.quest.0C9BA2223F3D4D33.title: Precision Steam Component
gtia.quest.0C9BA2223F3D4D33.subtitle: Every Large machine needs it.
gtia.quest.0C9BA2223F3D4D33.desc.0: Bronze gears, rods and springs around &eone&r small &6Steel Spring&r. Every Large steam controller of GTNA takes one or more; the Leap Forward furnace takes &efour&r.
gtia.quest.00BBCDAF61B4507A.title: Breel
gtia.quest.00BBCDAF61B4507A.subtitle: Bronze and Steel, mixed by hand.
gtia.quest.00BBCDAF61B4507A.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Bronze Dust&r and &eone&r &6Steel Dust&r on a crafting table make &ethree&r &6Breel Dust&r; a furnace turns it into ingots. Its tiny pipes go into several Large steam machines.
gtia.quest.2859530E8F91C14C.title: Brick Kiln
gtia.quest.2859530E8F91C14C.subtitle: A primitive kiln for ceramics.
gtia.quest.2859530E8F91C14C.desc.0: Wrought Iron rods, screws and a double plate around a &6Coke Oven Hatch&r. The structure is &6Firebricks&r, Bricks and Stone Bricks; check its preview.
gtia.quest.2859530E8F91C14C.desc.2: It fires bricks from compressed clay and coal without any steam, and it is where &6Clay Compound&r comes from.
gtia.quest.124C8D9FDCCC00E1.title: Clay Compound
gtia.quest.124C8D9FDCCC00E1.subtitle: Clay, stone and flint, fired.
gtia.quest.124C8D9FDCCC00E1.desc.0: &eEight&r each of &6Clay Dust&r, &6Stone Dust&r (from the Macerator) and &6Flint Dust&r in the Brick Kiln make &esixteen&r &6Clay Compound&r ingots. Hammer them into plates and gears for hydraulic parts.
gtia.quest.60E0845A289BE078.title: Hydraulic Piston
gtia.quest.60E0845A289BE078.subtitle: Clay Compound in motion.
gtia.quest.60E0845A289BE078.desc.0: A &6Hydraulic Motor&r is bronze gears and tiny pipes around an iron rotor. Add &ethree&r &6Clay Compound Plates&r and it becomes a &6Hydraulic Piston&r, the moving part of GTNA's Large steam machines.
gtia.quest.13E1320EF38F3A65.title: Hydraulic Conveyor
gtia.quest.13E1320EF38F3A65.subtitle: Rubber belts, steam muscles.
gtia.quest.13E1320EF38F3A65.desc.0: A belt of &6Rubber&r driven by a &6Hydraulic Motor&r. Four Large machines move their work with it: the Alloy Smelter, the Wiremill, the Cutter and the Bender.
gtia.quest.10043917A6960AA3.title: Steam Multiblocks
gtia.quest.10043917A6960AA3.subtitle: GTNA's Large machines, side by side.
gtia.quest.10043917A6960AA3.desc.0: Every Large steam machine GTNA makes possible in this age, in one place. Each is the multiblock version of a machine you already know and runs its recipes &din parallel&r, up to &e32 EU/t&r.
gtia.quest.10043917A6960AA3.desc.2: They all start from a &6Precision Steam Component&r; several need &6Hydraulic Pistons&r (Clay Compound from the Brick Kiln) or &6Breel&r pipes. &o&7Build the ones your factory is short of; none of them is required.&r
gtia.quest.6961142793AE9F7B.title: Large Steam Machines
gtia.quest.6961142793AE9F7B.subtitle: Four grinders in one machine.
gtia.quest.6961142793AE9F7B.desc.0: Crushes ore in parallel. Four Steam Grinders, Stronze Plates and a Precision Steam Component. It opens GTNA's Large steam line.
gtia.quest.6CD0424A8F315036.title: Large Steam Alloy Smelter
gtia.quest.6CD0424A8F315036.subtitle: Alloy Smelter, multiblock.
gtia.quest.6CD0424A8F315036.desc.0: Alloys in parallel. Its &6Hydraulic Conveyor&r needs Rubber Sheets.
gtia.quest.6BABFB2B1E621605.title: Large Steam Compressor
gtia.quest.6BABFB2B1E621605.subtitle: Compressor, multiblock.
gtia.quest.6BABFB2B1E621605.desc.0: Plates, blocks and bricks in bulk. Two &6Hydraulic Pistons&r and Stronze.
gtia.quest.24A0C4B65EF45179.title: Large Steam Hammer
gtia.quest.24A0C4B65EF45179.subtitle: Hammer, multiblock.
gtia.quest.24A0C4B65EF45179.desc.0: Plates and crushed ore in bulk, built around your Forge Hammer and an Anvil.
gtia.quest.4477A45D4485478D.title: Large Steam Furnace
gtia.quest.4477A45D4485478D.subtitle: Furnace, multiblock.
gtia.quest.4477A45D4485478D.desc.0: Smelting in bulk, with Stronze and &6Breel&r pipes.
gtia.quest.4BDCE20E098F475E.title: Large Steam Extractor
gtia.quest.4BDCE20E098F475E.subtitle: Extractor, multiblock.
gtia.quest.4BDCE20E098F475E.desc.0: Rubber in bulk. Glass, a Hydraulic Pump and a Hydraulic Piston.
gtia.quest.54115CC7B051BD9E.title: Large Steam Mixer
gtia.quest.54115CC7B051BD9E.subtitle: Mixer, multiblock.
gtia.quest.54115CC7B051BD9E.desc.0: &aThe Steam age's only mixer&r: Breel, Clay Compound and every mixer recipe up to &e32 EU/t&r.
gtia.quest.2A82174C947F4C30.title: Large Steam Centrifuge
gtia.quest.2A82174C947F4C30.subtitle: Centrifuge, multiblock.
gtia.quest.2A82174C947F4C30.desc.0: Splits dusts, resin and mixtures into their parts.
gtia.quest.6641AFACBF378E6D.title: Large Steam Thermal Centrifuge
gtia.quest.6641AFACBF378E6D.subtitle: Thermal Centrifuge, multiblock.
gtia.quest.6641AFACBF378E6D.desc.0: Heats purified ore apart for the byproducts the Macerator leaves behind.
gtia.quest.1B5B8702CD8CD184.title: Large Steam Ore Washer
gtia.quest.1B5B8702CD8CD184.subtitle: Ore Washer, multiblock.
gtia.quest.1B5B8702CD8CD184.desc.0: Washes crushed ore into purified ore, with water.
gtia.quest.07B87A06EAA80D2E.title: Large Steam Sifter
gtia.quest.07B87A06EAA80D2E.subtitle: Sifter, multiblock.
gtia.quest.3F22F9968DD21376.title: Large Steam Lathe
gtia.quest.3F22F9968DD21376.subtitle: Lathe, multiblock.
gtia.quest.0F86C18F9B565DBA.title: Large Steam Wiremill
gtia.quest.0F86C18F9B565DBA.subtitle: Wiremill, multiblock.
gtia.quest.0F86C18F9B565DBA.desc.0: Wires straight from ingots, without the wire cutter.
gtia.quest.10D4D19D6393D70F.title: Large Steam Cutting Machine
gtia.quest.10D4D19D6393D70F.subtitle: Cutting Machine, multiblock.
gtia.quest.10D4D19D6393D70F.desc.0: Cuts blocks into plates and rods into bolts, with water.
gtia.quest.30F6363FBD790EBB.title: Large Steam Bender
gtia.quest.30F6363FBD790EBB.subtitle: Bender, multiblock.
gtia.quest.30F6363FBD790EBB.desc.0: Bends ingots into plates and foils.
gtia.quest.12A3F0BDB61C4738.title: Large Steam Forming Press
gtia.quest.12A3F0BDB61C4738.subtitle: Forming Press, multiblock.
gtia.quest.0B6B99B114BE146C.title: Large Steam Solar Boiler
gtia.quest.0B6B99B114BE146C.subtitle: Solar Boiler, multiblock.
gtia.quest.0B6B99B114BE146C.desc.0: &aSteam from the sun at scale&r: no fuel, &cnothing at night&r.
gtia.quest.41D6A548289FF42F.title: Leap Forward Blast Furnace
gtia.quest.41D6A548289FF42F.subtitle: Leap Forward Blast Furnace, multiblock.
gtia.quest.41D6A548289FF42F.desc.0: Your Primitive Blast Furnace and &efour&r Precision Steam Components make GTNA's giant blast furnace: the same Steel recipes, many at once. &o&7The structure is huge; check its preview.&r
gtia.quest.2890D60ACDE4959D.title: Primitive Stone Furnace
gtia.quest.2890D60ACDE4959D.subtitle: Primitive Stone Furnace, multiblock.
gtia.quest.15C7D95DE420E74C.title: Cactus Wonder
gtia.quest.15C7D95DE420E74C.subtitle: Cactus Wonder, multiblock.
gtia.quest.15C7D95DE420E74C.desc.0: Cactus, bronze brick casings and a Hydraulic Regulator. It burns carbon fuels into steam: &e8000 mB&r per Coal or Charcoal, &e90000&r per block, &e16000&r per Coke, &e180000&r per Coke block.
gtia.quest.10A2B48FED1F6AC6.title: Steel Plates
gtia.quest.10A2B48FED1F6AC6.subtitle: Hammer them, do not waste them.
gtia.quest.10A2B48FED1F6AC6.desc.0: The Forge Hammer gets &etwo&r plates out of &ethree&r ingots. Molds, bolts and every Low Voltage hull start here.
gtia.quest.0EBD82984EF14E81.title: Empty Mold
gtia.quest.0EBD82984EF14E81.subtitle: Four plates, a hammer and a file.
gtia.quest.0EBD82984EF14E81.desc.0: &eFour&r &6Steel Plates&r with a hammer and a file. Hammer an Empty Mold again to give it a shape.
gtia.quest.0EBD82984EF14E81.desc.2: &aMolds are never used up. One of each shape is enough.&r
gtia.quest.392F0978473E4D96.title: Block Mold
gtia.quest.392F0978473E4D96.subtitle: For glass.
gtia.quest.392F0978473E4D96.desc.0: In the Alloy Smelter, the &6Block&r mold turns &6Glass Dust&r into &6Glass&r.
gtia.quest.5BB7C360D019CF54.title: Plate Mold
gtia.quest.5BB7C360D019CF54.subtitle: For rubber sheets.
gtia.quest.5BB7C360D019CF54.desc.0: In the Alloy Smelter, the &6Plate&r mold turns &etwo&r &6Rubber Bars&r into a &6Rubber Sheet&r.
gtia.quest.42A7A0ACDDB1588D.title: Ball Mold
gtia.quest.42A7A0ACDDB1588D.subtitle: For glass tubes.
gtia.quest.42A7A0ACDDB1588D.desc.0: In the Alloy Smelter, the &6Ball&r mold turns &6Glass Dust&r into a &6Glass Tube&r.
gtia.quest.3F1DCA7419D19774.title: Glass
gtia.quest.3F1DCA7419D19774.subtitle: No furnace makes it here.
gtia.quest.3F1DCA7419D19774.desc.0: &cSand does not smelt into Glass in this pack.&r Grind &6Sand&r into &6Quartz Sand&r and &6Flint&r into &6Flint Dust&r with the mortar, mix them into &6Glass Dust&r, and cast it with the Block mold.
gtia.quest.2C599B6E18221391.title: Extractor
gtia.quest.2C599B6E18221391.subtitle: It needs a pane of glass.
gtia.quest.2C599B6E18221391.desc.0: A &6Piston&r, a pane of &6Glass&r and bronze pipes. It pulls &ethree&r &6Raw Rubber Dust&r out of each &6Sticky Resin&r.
gtia.quest.2D29E34885BE4BDE.title: Sticky Resin
gtia.quest.2D29E34885BE4BDE.subtitle: Tap the rubber trees.
gtia.quest.2D29E34885BE4BDE.desc.0: Rubber trees give Sticky Resin. It becomes Resistors, the resin Circuit Board and, in the Extractor, Raw Rubber.
gtia.quest.30B5CF8757F9BF2D.title: Raw Rubber
gtia.quest.30B5CF8757F9BF2D.subtitle: The rubber trees pay off.
gtia.quest.30B5CF8757F9BF2D.desc.0: &6Sticky Resin&r gives the most; rubber logs, saplings and leaves give a little.
gtia.quest.625DD74AEAFA5AA4.title: Rubber Bar
gtia.quest.625DD74AEAFA5AA4.subtitle: Dust and sulfur.
gtia.quest.625DD74AEAFA5AA4.desc.0: &eThree&r &6Raw Rubber Dust&r and &eone&r &6Sulfur Dust&r in the Alloy Smelter.
gtia.quest.625DD74AEAFA5AA4.desc.2: &o&7The recipe viewer shows where Sulfur comes from.&r
gtia.quest.52E07B2FAD21E496.title: Rubber Sheet
gtia.quest.52E07B2FAD21E496.subtitle: Insulation for wires.
gtia.quest.52E07B2FAD21E496.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Rubber Bars&r and the Plate mold in the Alloy Smelter.
gtia.quest.04D883B83F0A5B75.title: Red Alloy Cable
gtia.quest.04D883B83F0A5B75.subtitle: A wire you can touch.
gtia.quest.04D883B83F0A5B75.desc.0: A &6Red Alloy Wire&r and a &6Rubber Sheet&r, crafted together. &cBare wires shock whoever touches them.&r
gtia.quest.5A2F18CD6FB50ABA.title: Glass Tube
gtia.quest.5A2F18CD6FB50ABA.subtitle: Glass dust in the Ball mold.
gtia.quest.5A2F18CD6FB50ABA.desc.0: &6Glass Dust&r and the Ball mold in the Alloy Smelter.
gtia.quest.39008B4252E18D4F.title: Vacuum Tube
gtia.quest.39008B4252E18D4F.subtitle: The first electronic part.
gtia.quest.39008B4252E18D4F.desc.0: A &6Glass Tube&r, &etwo&r &6Steel Bolts&r and &ethree&r &6Copper Wires&r. A saw cuts Steel Rods into bolts.
gtia.quest.09CD4AE957693FF7.title: Resistors
gtia.quest.09CD4AE957693FF7.subtitle: Paper, resin, carbon and copper.
gtia.quest.09CD4AE957693FF7.desc.0: &6Sticky Resin&r, &6Paper&r, &6Copper Wire&r and &6Coal&r or &6Charcoal Dust&r make &etwo&r &6Resistors&r by hand.
gtia.quest.1462856644D0B984.title: Circuit Board
gtia.quest.1462856644D0B984.subtitle: Wood, resin and copper.
gtia.quest.1462856644D0B984.desc.0: &6Wood Plates&r (wood dust from the Macerator, pressed in the Compressor) coated in &6Sticky Resin&r make a &6Resin Circuit Board&r. &eEight&r &6Copper Wires&r around it print the circuit.
gtia.quest.6953C899271F3796.title: The First Circuit
gtia.quest.6953C899271F3796.subtitle: The key to Low Voltage.
gtia.quest.6953C899271F3796.desc.0: &eTwo&r &6Vacuum Tubes&r, &etwo&r &6Resistors&r, the printed board, a &6Steel Plate&r and &ethree&r &6Red Alloy Cables&r: the &6Basic Electronic Circuit&r. Every Low Voltage machine needs at least one.
gtia.quest.69CA084126822E92.title: Large Bronze Boiler
gtia.quest.69CA084126822E92.subtitle: A first job for your circuits.
gtia.quest.69CA084126822E92.desc.0: Its controller asks for &6Basic Electronic Circuits&r and &6Tin Cables&r. The Power Generation chapter compares it with the other ways of making steam.
gtia.quest.41499D4881126224.title: LV Machine Casing
gtia.quest.41499D4881126224.subtitle: Eight Steel Plates and a wrench.
gtia.quest.41499D4881126224.desc.0: The shell of every Low Voltage machine: &e8 Steel Plates&r bent around a wrench. It is the reason your Steel line has to keep running.
gtia.quest.5AF28B9BC8D75791.title: Tin Cable
gtia.quest.5AF28B9BC8D75791.subtitle: Insulated, at last.
gtia.quest.5AF28B9BC8D75791.desc.0: A &6Tin Wire&r wrapped in a &6Rubber Sheet&r. Bare wires hurt; cables do not. The LV hull takes two.
gtia.quest.0714D70458EEC997.title: LV Machine Hull
gtia.quest.0714D70458EEC997.subtitle: The body of every electric machine.
gtia.quest.0714D70458EEC997.desc.0: Casing, &etwo&r Tin Cables, &etwo&r Wrought Iron Plates and a Steel Plate. With a circuit in the other hand, Low Voltage is one step away.
gtia.quest.1470DD8318DF0F60.title: Wood in the Coke Oven
gtia.quest.1470DD8318DF0F60.subtitle: Cook wood without air.
gtia.quest.1470DD8318DF0F60.desc.0: A furnace burns wood. The &6Coke Oven&r cooks it without air, and the wood comes apart: &e4 logs&r give &e3 Charcoal&r and &e1,000 mB&r of &6Charcoal Byproducts&r every &e30 s&r, with no fuel at all. Coke Oven Hatches automate it.
gtia.quest.1470DD8318DF0F60.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r until the 1920s, almost all of the world's methanol came from cooking wood. That is why it was called wood alcohol.
gtia.quest.278E9258DFD1E67A.title: Charcoal Byproducts
gtia.quest.278E9258DFD1E67A.subtitle: Smells like a campfire with a chemistry degree.
gtia.quest.278E9258DFD1E67A.desc.0: The liquid in the Coke Oven's tank is a mix of wood vinegar and tar. You cannot separate it yet: keep it in tanks. In Low Voltage, the &6Distillery&r cuts it into acid, alcohol and creosote.
gtia.quest.278E9258DFD1E67A.desc.2: &eThree Coke Ovens&r on logs fill exactly one LV Distillery.
gtia.quest.6637F16316206C88.title: Calcite Dust
gtia.quest.6637F16316206C88.subtitle: Rocks in, hotter rocks out.
gtia.quest.6637F16316206C88.desc.0: Calcite is limestone. Burn it and it becomes &6Quicklime&r: &e4 Calcite Dust&r in the &6Coke Oven&r give &e4 Quicklime&r in &e20 s&r; the CO₂ goes up the chimney.
gtia.quest.6637F16316206C88.desc.2: Calcite blocks line dripstone caves and amethyst geodes; the Steam Macerator turns them into dust.
gtia.quest.6637F16316206C88.desc.4: &aReal fact:&r lime kilns are older than writing.
gtia.quest.724D0AD550E0BFFE.title: Fluxed Steel
gtia.quest.724D0AD550E0BFFE.subtitle: Faster steel, same furnace.
gtia.quest.724D0AD550E0BFFE.desc.0: Add Quicklime to the Primitive Blast Furnace: &e2 Wrought Iron&r, &e2 Charcoal&r (or Coal) and &e1 Quicklime&r give &e2 Steel&r in &e50 s&r. That is &e2.4 Steel&r a minute per furnace, against &e1.5&r without it.
gtia.quest.724D0AD550E0BFFE.desc.2: One Coke Oven on calcite keeps about ten furnaces fluxed.
gtia.quest.724D0AD550E0BFFE.desc.4: &aReal fact:&r real blast furnaces add limestone as flux. It grabs the sulfur and the sand and floats them off as slag.
gtia.quest.7E683D21CB6D6CCD.title: Ascend to Low Voltage
gtia.quest.7E683D21CB6D6CCD.subtitle: Steam stays; electricity begins.
gtia.quest.7E683D21CB6D6CCD.desc.0: You hold a circuit. Your boilers keep running: the Low Voltage chapter turns their steam into electricity and builds the first electric machines.
gtia.quest.5122FC31C1635F38.title: Low Voltage Age
gtia.quest.5122FC31C1635F38.subtitle: Ascension II
gtia.quest.5122FC31C1635F38.desc.0: Electricity changes how you work: machines get faster, cables carry power, and chemistry finally gets its own tools. This Ascension ends where Medium Voltage begins: a &6Good Electronic Circuit&r in one hand and an &6MV Machine Hull&r in the other.
gtia.quest.71341351BDAFCF25.title: Electric Age
gtia.quest.71341351BDAFCF25.subtitle: Your boilers, now making EU.
gtia.quest.71341351BDAFCF25.desc.0: You already make steam. An &6LV Steam Turbine&r turns it into &e32 V&r of electricity. Every machine in this chapter runs on it.
gtia.quest.71341351BDAFCF25.desc.2: &aCheck the Power Generation chapter for every other way to make EU.&r
gtia.quest.3D52939CFFC5D048.title: LV Electric Motor
gtia.quest.3D52939CFFC5D048.subtitle: Copper, iron and a magnet.
gtia.quest.3D52939CFFC5D048.desc.0: Four copper wires around a magnetic iron rod. Almost every LV machine has one or two inside, so you will build a lot of them.
gtia.quest.3D52939CFFC5D048.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r the first practical electric motors (1830s) also ran on copper coils and iron, just bigger and much angrier.
gtia.quest.698F1344C25DB97A.title: LV Electric Piston
gtia.quest.698F1344C25DB97A.subtitle: Push.
gtia.quest.698F1344C25DB97A.desc.0: A motor, steel plates and a small gear. Benders, Lathes and the Robot Arm all need it.
gtia.quest.111F924A2481CFA7.title: LV Electric Pump
gtia.quest.111F924A2481CFA7.subtitle: Move fluids.
gtia.quest.111F924A2481CFA7.desc.0: A motor, a rotor and a tin pipe. The Extractor, Brewery, Fermenter and Fluid Heater use it.
gtia.quest.5645FC30B1403DA3.title: LV Conveyor Module
gtia.quest.5645FC30B1403DA3.subtitle: Move items.
gtia.quest.5645FC30B1403DA3.desc.0: Two motors and rubber plates. The Assembler needs two of them.
gtia.quest.517A6D218C50690F.title: LV Robot Arm
gtia.quest.517A6D218C50690F.subtitle: Grab and place.
gtia.quest.517A6D218C50690F.desc.0: Two motors, a piston and a circuit. It is the hand of the Assembler and of the Circuit Assembler.
gtia.quest.6A1A8F046C4A943F.title: Quartzite
gtia.quest.6A1A8F046C4A943F.subtitle: A clear gem for sensors.
gtia.quest.6A1A8F046C4A943F.desc.0: Quartzite gems sit in the eye of the LV Sensor and the LV Emitter. Look for them in quartz veins.
gtia.quest.16ABC275597DC723.title: Brass Rods
gtia.quest.16ABC275597DC723.subtitle: Copper and zinc.
gtia.quest.16ABC275597DC723.desc.0: Brass from the Alloy Smelter, turned into rods. The LV Sensor and Emitter are framed with them.
gtia.quest.54D9368C38E62663.title: LV Sensor
gtia.quest.54D9368C38E62663.subtitle: It notices things.
gtia.quest.54D9368C38E62663.desc.0: Quartzite, a brass rod, steel plates and a basic circuit. Covers and later machines read the world through it.
gtia.quest.1B224202BF9723BC.title: LV Emitter
gtia.quest.1B224202BF9723BC.subtitle: It sends things out.
gtia.quest.1B224202BF9723BC.desc.0: Four brass rods around Quartzite, with tin cables and circuits. The LV Circuit Assembler needs one.
gtia.quest.74B0F4E910DBCE06.title: LV Field Generator
gtia.quest.74B0F4E910DBCE06.subtitle: Optional: a pocket of force.
gtia.quest.74B0F4E910DBCE06.desc.0: An Ender Pearl inside Manganese Phosphide wire. Not needed now, but good to know it exists.
gtia.quest.191CB01FF356FA8C.title: LV Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.191CB01FF356FA8C.subtitle: Power into a big machine.
gtia.quest.191CB01FF356FA8C.desc.0: A multiblock has no power slot of its own: it draws EU through an &6Energy Hatch&r in its wall. Make two.
gtia.quest.191CB01FF356FA8C.desc.2: &aTwo LV Energy Hatches on the same machine count as one MV hatch. That is how the furnace reaches Aluminium.&r
gtia.quest.23493BC1D9D43A0A.title: Buses and Hatches
gtia.quest.23493BC1D9D43A0A.subtitle: Items and fluids in and out.
gtia.quest.23493BC1D9D43A0A.desc.0: &6Buses&r carry items and &6Hatches&r carry fluids, through the walls of a multiblock. The Assembler seals them with Glue (or, later, plastic). The Electric Blast Furnace needs them.
gtia.quest.2D7482D6B779CB3D.title: Assembler
gtia.quest.2D7482D6B779CB3D.subtitle: The machine that makes machines.
gtia.quest.2D7482D6B779CB3D.desc.0: From here on, most components are cheaper in an Assembler than by hand.
gtia.quest.6673898CC95A84FC.title: Wiremill
gtia.quest.6673898CC95A84FC.subtitle: One ingot, two wires.
gtia.quest.6673898CC95A84FC.desc.0: Twice the wire from the same ingot, and no Wire Cutter wear.
gtia.quest.538AAC9F58F9CAFD.title: Bender
gtia.quest.538AAC9F58F9CAFD.subtitle: Plates without the hammer.
gtia.quest.538AAC9F58F9CAFD.desc.0: One ingot, one plate, and foils for the coils you will need soon.
gtia.quest.25D7A110A873AC6B.title: Lathe
gtia.quest.25D7A110A873AC6B.subtitle: Rods and bolts.
gtia.quest.25D7A110A873AC6B.desc.0: Two rods from one ingot instead of one by hand.
gtia.quest.1CB629D38D0B1206.title: Polarizer
gtia.quest.1CB629D38D0B1206.subtitle: Magnets, automated.
gtia.quest.1CB629D38D0B1206.desc.0: Magnetic rods without the redstone. Your motor line will thank you.
gtia.quest.01255CFD0A84881B.title: LV Voltage Coil
gtia.quest.01255CFD0A84881B.subtitle: The heart of an Energy Hatch.
gtia.quest.01255CFD0A84881B.desc.0: Sixteen fine steel wires around a magnetic iron rod, in the Assembler.
gtia.quest.048FC4DD02909F5B.title: LV Extractor
gtia.quest.048FC4DD02909F5B.subtitle: Squeeze, but electrically.
gtia.quest.048FC4DD02909F5B.desc.0: Melts metals into fluids for the Assembler and gets rubber out of resin faster.
gtia.quest.50EA9AC05C27F284.title: Circuit Assembler
gtia.quest.50EA9AC05C27F284.subtitle: Circuits by the stack.
gtia.quest.50EA9AC05C27F284.desc.0: Cheaper circuits, and the only way to make integrated circuits later.
gtia.quest.230D7F721E274053.title: Fluid Solidifier
gtia.quest.230D7F721E274053.subtitle: Fluids back into shapes.
gtia.quest.230D7F721E274053.desc.0: With a mold, molten metal and liquid plastics become plates, ingots and bars.
gtia.quest.20EC7F7C7CE0AE76.title: Mixer
gtia.quest.20EC7F7C7CE0AE76.subtitle: Dusts in, alloys out.
gtia.quest.20EC7F7C7CE0AE76.desc.0: Mixes dusts and fluids. Invar, Cupronickel and Salt Water all start here.
gtia.quest.225A7837821FDE98.title: Electrolyzer
gtia.quest.225A7837821FDE98.subtitle: Split it with a current.
gtia.quest.225A7837821FDE98.desc.0: Breaks compounds into their elements. Bauxite becomes aluminium dust here, the expensive way.
gtia.quest.44D8CABA778F9F26.title: Centrifuge
gtia.quest.44D8CABA778F9F26.subtitle: Spin it until it gives up.
gtia.quest.44D8CABA778F9F26.desc.0: Separates by weight: ore byproducts, resin, air and the Cell Liquor of the chlor-alkali line.
gtia.quest.4F5A80D051813401.title: Glue
gtia.quest.4F5A80D051813401.subtitle: Sticky Resin, spun.
gtia.quest.4F5A80D051813401.desc.0: The Centrifuge separates Sticky Resin into rubber and a little &6Glue&r. It is enough for your first buses and boards; the wood line below makes it in bulk.
gtia.quest.07B07245F02E7787.title: Chemical Reactor
gtia.quest.07B07245F02E7787.subtitle: Where chemistry happens.
gtia.quest.07B07245F02E7787.desc.0: Two inputs, two outputs and a lot of possibilities. Most of this chapter's chemistry runs here.
gtia.quest.07B07245F02E7787.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r industrial reactors are mostly very expensive kettles. So is this one.
gtia.quest.49F8A2C33A7E812E.title: Fluid Heater
gtia.quest.49F8A2C33A7E812E.subtitle: Steam without a boiler.
gtia.quest.49F8A2C33A7E812E.desc.0: Heats water into steam on electricity alone. Pipe it into the Chemical Reactor's ethanol dehydration (circuit 2) and every batch takes half the time.
gtia.quest.1FC6DB76FA90EDFD.title: Chlor-Alkali
gtia.quest.1FC6DB76FA90EDFD.subtitle: Salt water, split three ways.
gtia.quest.1FC6DB76FA90EDFD.desc.0: Electricity through salt water gives &6Chlorine&r, &6Hydrogen&r and a salty caustic &6Cell Liquor&r: &e4,000 mB&r of Salt Water every &e15 s&r at &e30 EU/t&r in the &6Electrolyzer&r. The &6Asbestos Diaphragm&r goes in with the brine and wears out &e1%&r of the time.
gtia.quest.1FC6DB76FA90EDFD.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r chlorine and caustic soda always come out together, in the same ratio. The industry has to sell both; chemists call it the chlor-alkali balance.
gtia.quest.186220CDDFF52D50.title: Asbestos Diaphragm
gtia.quest.186220CDDFF52D50.subtitle: It wears out. Keep spares.
gtia.quest.186220CDDFF52D50.desc.0: The cell needs one in its Input Bus. Each run has a &e1%&r chance to use it up.
gtia.quest.186220CDDFF52D50.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r the first industrial cells really used asbestos. Modern plants switched to polymer membranes. You will too, later.
gtia.quest.1931522EEAF2AF90.title: Cell Liquor
gtia.quest.1931522EEAF2AF90.subtitle: Half of the salt comes back.
gtia.quest.1931522EEAF2AF90.desc.0: A Centrifuge splits &e2,000 mB&r of Cell Liquor into &e1 Sodium Hydroxide&r, &e1 Salt&r and water. Send the salt back to the Mixer: the line only eats one fresh salt per soda.
gtia.quest.1931522EEAF2AF90.desc.2: Stockpile the soda: in Medium Voltage it digests Bauxite into alumina.
gtia.quest.4117933B0EAACD09.title: Hydrochloric Acid
gtia.quest.4117933B0EAACD09.subtitle: Burn the two gases together.
gtia.quest.4117933B0EAACD09.desc.0: The cell's Chlorine and Hydrogen react into Hydrochloric Acid. One reactor handles a whole cell. The circuit boards need it as Iron III Chloride.
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.title: Distillery
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.subtitle: Copper, heat and patience.
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.desc.0: At LV the &6Distillery&r cuts the wood liquids one fraction per circuit, at &e30 EU/t&r:
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.desc.2: - Charcoal Byproducts: circuit 11 → &e250 mB&r Wood Tar, circuit 12 → &e400 mB&r Wood Vinegar
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.desc.3: - Wood Vinegar: circuit 11 → &e100 mB&r Acetic Acid, circuit 12 → &e40 mB&r Methanol
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.desc.6: &eThree Coke Ovens&r on logs keep one Distillery busy.
gtia.quest.1DE26A3DCA073B37.desc.8: &aReal fact:&r wood vinegar is about ninety percent water. The rest is what makes smoked ham taste like smoked ham.
gtia.quest.0690FF584ED3E0EE.title: Acetic Acid and Methanol
gtia.quest.0690FF584ED3E0EE.subtitle: Vinegar and wood alcohol, the expensive way.
gtia.quest.0690FF584ED3E0EE.desc.0: Not much of either: this is the early route. The MV Distillery gets far more out of the same wood.
gtia.quest.0690FF584ED3E0EE.desc.2: &aSpare Methanol burns in the Combustion Generator.&r
gtia.quest.6887D0AFB294C629.title: Methyl Acetate
gtia.quest.6887D0AFB294C629.subtitle: Both cuts, in one solvent.
gtia.quest.6887D0AFB294C629.desc.0: Acetic Acid and Methanol, &e1,000 mB&r each, in the Chemical Reactor. It smells like nail polish remover, because that is what it is.
gtia.quest.59B363797364D346.title: Vinyl Acetate
gtia.quest.59B363797364D346.subtitle: Where the wood meets the plants.
gtia.quest.59B363797364D346.desc.0: Acetic Acid from the Distillery, Ethylene from the dehydration and Oxygen. Two lines of this chapter, one molecule.
gtia.quest.2F1CC1AA884A4CC0.title: Polyvinyl Acetate
gtia.quest.2F1CC1AA884A4CC0.subtitle: White glue, before the glue.
gtia.quest.2F1CC1AA884A4CC0.desc.0: Vinyl Acetate and Oxygen in the Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.2F1CC1AA884A4CC0.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r this is the white school glue in every classroom.
gtia.quest.4B7DC2D9A21F7755.title: Glue in Bulk
gtia.quest.4B7DC2D9A21F7755.subtitle: The route that scales.
gtia.quest.4B7DC2D9A21F7755.desc.0: &e1,000 mB&r of Polyvinyl Acetate and &e1,500 mB&r of Methyl Acetate give &e2,500 mB&r of Glue in the Mixer, far more than resin ever will. Buses, boards and resistors all drink it.
gtia.quest.4F3F237FB29530E9.title: Creosote
gtia.quest.4F3F237FB29530E9.subtitle: The tar, refined.
gtia.quest.4F3F237FB29530E9.desc.0: Circuit 11 on the Distillery: &e1,000 mB&r of Wood Tar gives &e400 mB&r of Creosote. It burns in boilers and protects planks, but its best use is next.
gtia.quest.2C3DA47A4BC52667.title: Brewery
gtia.quest.2C3DA47A4BC52667.subtitle: Not for beer. Mostly.
gtia.quest.2C3DA47A4BC52667.desc.0: Mixes a fluid with a dust without heat. Its best early job is Lubricant.
gtia.quest.7F1F162BFC9F8B9E.title: Lubricant
gtia.quest.7F1F162BFC9F8B9E.subtitle: Grease for the saws.
gtia.quest.7F1F162BFC9F8B9E.desc.0: Creosote and a Talc, Soapstone or Redstone dust in the &6Brewery&r. Every Cutter recipe drinks it, and you will cut silicon in Medium Voltage.
gtia.quest.3B201ABFAD079376.title: Fermenter
gtia.quest.3B201ABFAD079376.subtitle: Sugar into Ethanol.
gtia.quest.3B201ABFAD079376.desc.0: Yeast turns &e2 Sugar&r and &e100 mB&r of water into &e50 mB&r of &6Ethanol&r: the feed of the dehydration and a fuel of its own. The &6Brewery&r turns plants into Biomass, if you want the long way.
gtia.quest.531706A7A114B6AC.title: Catalytic Dehydration
gtia.quest.531706A7A114B6AC.subtitle: Ethanol into Ethylene.
gtia.quest.531706A7A114B6AC.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, circuit 1 turns &e225 mB&r of Ethanol into &e225 mB&r of &6Ethylene&r and water.
gtia.quest.531706A7A114B6AC.desc.2: &aCircuit 2 with 100 mB of steam takes 200 ticks instead of 400.&r
gtia.quest.4E63E824B2724FAB.title: Polyethylene
gtia.quest.4E63E824B2724FAB.subtitle: Your first plastic, from plants.
gtia.quest.4E63E824B2724FAB.desc.0: Ethylene and Oxygen in a Chemical Reactor make liquid &6Polyethylene&r. The diodes of the next circuit need it.
gtia.quest.4E63E824B2724FAB.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r polyethylene was discovered by accident in 1933, when an experiment with ethylene left a waxy white solid nobody had asked for.
gtia.quest.16068E27970DD544.title: Invar
gtia.quest.16068E27970DD544.subtitle: Iron that does not stretch.
gtia.quest.16068E27970DD544.desc.0: Two Iron and one Nickel. It barely expands with heat, which is why the furnace casing is made of it.
gtia.quest.55DF3D7B7656A62E.title: Heat Proof Casing
gtia.quest.55DF3D7B7656A62E.subtitle: Walls for a hot furnace.
gtia.quest.55DF3D7B7656A62E.desc.0: Invar plates around an Invar frame. The Electric Blast Furnace needs a lot of them.
gtia.quest.41B23A0FC48E64E9.title: Cupronickel
gtia.quest.41B23A0FC48E64E9.subtitle: Copper and nickel, half and half.
gtia.quest.41B23A0FC48E64E9.desc.0: One Copper dust and one Nickel dust in the Mixer, then a furnace. The coils are wound from its wire.
gtia.quest.41B23A0FC48E64E9.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r most silver-coloured coins in the world are cupronickel.
gtia.quest.0895DA51A5D5C386.title: Tin Alloy
gtia.quest.0895DA51A5D5C386.subtitle: Solder for the coils.
gtia.quest.0895DA51A5D5C386.desc.0: Iron and Tin in the Mixer. The Extractor melts it into the fluid the coil recipe needs.
gtia.quest.2846FCAFA5420008.title: Cupronickel Coils
gtia.quest.2846FCAFA5420008.subtitle: 1800 K of heating.
gtia.quest.2846FCAFA5420008.desc.0: Eight Cupronickel double wires, eight Bronze foils (Bender) and &e144 mB&r of molten Tin Alloy (Extractor), in the Assembler. Eight coils ring the furnace.
gtia.quest.16DD3A8F254586F7.title: Electric Blast Furnace
gtia.quest.16DD3A8F254586F7.subtitle: Hotter than any primitive furnace.
gtia.quest.16DD3A8F254586F7.desc.0: Coils, casings, an Energy Hatch, Input and Output Buses, a Maintenance Hatch and a Muffler. With &etwo&r LV Energy Hatches it reaches the voltage Aluminium needs.
gtia.quest.16DD3A8F254586F7.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r the first electric arc furnace for steel ran in 1900. It is still how most recycled steel is made today.
gtia.quest.087182F9C03AE7E9.title: Aluminium Dust
gtia.quest.087182F9C03AE7E9.subtitle: Where the metal hides.
gtia.quest.087182F9C03AE7E9.desc.0: Aluminium ore gives it directly; Bauxite, Ruby and Sapphire give it in the Electrolyzer. Either way, it goes into the furnace as dust.
gtia.quest.3500CC136820664F.title: Aluminium
gtia.quest.3500CC136820664F.subtitle: The metal of Medium Voltage.
gtia.quest.3500CC136820664F.desc.0: &e1700 K&r and &e120 EU/t&r: Cupronickel coils and two LV Energy Hatches. Slow and costly, but it is enough for the MV hull. In Medium Voltage the Hall-Héroult recipe makes it in bulk from Bauxite.
gtia.quest.3500CC136820664F.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r aluminium was once more precious than gold. Napoleon III kept aluminium cutlery for his most important guests.
gtia.quest.62D63EDD6AA0E846.title: Silver Foil
gtia.quest.62D63EDD6AA0E846.subtitle: Thin enough to etch.
gtia.quest.62D63EDD6AA0E846.desc.0: Silver from Galena, rolled into foil. The circuit boards print on it.
gtia.quest.7D2C996588E7D20B.title: Phenolic Board
gtia.quest.7D2C996588E7D20B.subtitle: Wood, glue, pressure.
gtia.quest.7D2C996588E7D20B.desc.0: Wood dust and &e50 mB&r of Glue in the Assembler: the blank board of the next circuit.
gtia.quest.17340139ABA70F9B.title: Iron III Chloride
gtia.quest.17340139ABA70F9B.subtitle: The etching bath.
gtia.quest.17340139ABA70F9B.desc.0: Iron dust in Hydrochloric Acid, in a Chemical Reactor. It eats away the copper the board does not need.
gtia.quest.3A48AA90447182C7.title: Phenolic Printed Board
gtia.quest.3A48AA90447182C7.subtitle: Etched, not wired.
gtia.quest.3A48AA90447182C7.desc.0: Board, silver foil and the etching bath, in a Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.73CCA5F10D92ADAA.title: Gallium Arsenide
gtia.quest.73CCA5F10D92ADAA.subtitle: A rare metal from a common ore.
gtia.quest.73CCA5F10D92ADAA.desc.0: Gallium hides in Sphalerite and Bauxite; the Electrolyzer gets it out. Mixed with Arsenic, it becomes the semiconductor of your first diodes.
gtia.quest.73CCA5F10D92ADAA.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r almost all the world's gallium is a byproduct of making aluminium from bauxite.
gtia.quest.34950D96E3392D92.title: Diodes
gtia.quest.34950D96E3392D92.subtitle: Current goes one way.
gtia.quest.34950D96E3392D92.desc.0: Fine copper wire, a small pile of Gallium Arsenide and Polyethylene, in the Assembler.
gtia.quest.685C3F6D5275BA1B.title: Good Electronic Circuit
gtia.quest.685C3F6D5275BA1B.subtitle: The MV circuit.
gtia.quest.685C3F6D5275BA1B.desc.0: A printed board, three basic circuits, two diodes and copper wire. It is the circuit every MV machine asks for.
gtia.quest.67C7BDF64377EBB9.title: Aluminium Plates
gtia.quest.67C7BDF64377EBB9.subtitle: Light and strong.
gtia.quest.67C7BDF64377EBB9.desc.0: Nine plates: eight for the casing and one for the hull.
gtia.quest.46FC65E4EE4FB81B.title: MV Machine Casing
gtia.quest.46FC65E4EE4FB81B.subtitle: Eight Aluminium Plates.
gtia.quest.46FC65E4EE4FB81B.desc.0: The shell of every Medium Voltage machine.
gtia.quest.41D96BAED3CA1B2C.title: Copper Cable
gtia.quest.41D96BAED3CA1B2C.subtitle: More amps than tin.
gtia.quest.41D96BAED3CA1B2C.desc.0: Copper wire in rubber. The MV hull takes two.
gtia.quest.3AAFB280D9285FA8.title: MV Machine Hull
gtia.quest.3AAFB280D9285FA8.subtitle: The body of every MV machine.
gtia.quest.3AAFB280D9285FA8.desc.0: Casing, two Copper Cables, two Wrought Iron Plates and an Aluminium Plate.
gtia.quest.355578D8EBE7AC17.title: Applied Energistics
gtia.quest.355578D8EBE7AC17.subtitle: Storage that thinks.
gtia.quest.355578D8EBE7AC17.desc.0: A ME Controller, a drive and a terminal: every item in one network. Autocrafting comes in Medium Voltage.
gtia.quest.418F6715590E84F5.title: LV Multiblocks
gtia.quest.418F6715590E84F5.subtitle: What GTNA builds at LV.
gtia.quest.418F6715590E84F5.desc.0: Optional multiblocks that make sense from LV on. None of them is required.
gtia.quest.00D3788C0EE00D62.title: Generator Array
gtia.quest.00D3788C0EE00D62.subtitle: Optional.
gtia.quest.00D3788C0EE00D62.desc.0: A GTNA multiblock available from LV.
gtia.quest.684D6F30647C9FB4.title: Liquefaction Furnace
gtia.quest.684D6F30647C9FB4.subtitle: Optional.
gtia.quest.684D6F30647C9FB4.desc.0: A GTNA multiblock available from LV.
gtia.quest.56BDDDCB63432E62.title: Primitive Distillation Tower
gtia.quest.56BDDDCB63432E62.subtitle: Optional.
gtia.quest.56BDDDCB63432E62.desc.0: A GTNA multiblock available from LV.
gtia.quest.2F9EA9296E7797D1.title: Voltage and Amperage
gtia.quest.2F9EA9296E7797D1.subtitle: Power comes in packets.
gtia.quest.2F9EA9296E7797D1.desc.0: Every tier has a voltage: &e32 EU/t&r for LV, &e128&r for MV, &e512&r for HV. Power moves in packets of that size, and the amperage is how many packets per tick.
gtia.quest.2F9EA9296E7797D1.desc.2: A machine fed a higher voltage than its own &cexplodes&r. A machine only draws the amps it needs, so one generator can feed several machines of its tier.
gtia.quest.093178B26BFC220F.title: Cable Loss
gtia.quest.093178B26BFC220F.subtitle: Short cables, thick cables.
gtia.quest.093178B26BFC220F.desc.0: Every cable loses a little EU per block; the tooltip shows how much and how many amps it carries. Keep generators close to the machines.
gtia.quest.093178B26BFC220F.desc.2: A bare wire carrying power &cshocks&r whoever touches it. Cover it with rubber to make a cable.
gtia.quest.351442D9F08D15BA.title: Covers
gtia.quest.351442D9F08D15BA.subtitle: Machines that move things by themselves.
gtia.quest.351442D9F08D15BA.desc.0: Right-click the side of a machine with a &6Conveyor Module&r or an &6Electric Pump&r to put it there as a cover: it pushes or pulls items or fluids through that side. Open it to set the direction and the rate.
gtia.quest.351442D9F08D15BA.desc.2: Machines can also push their own output: the wrench sets the output side, and a button in the machine's screen turns auto-output on.
gtia.quest.560B95AA0A068055.title: Programmed Circuits
gtia.quest.560B95AA0A068055.subtitle: Same inputs, different recipe.
gtia.quest.560B95AA0A068055.desc.0: When two recipes use the same inputs, a &6Programmed Circuit&r picks which one runs. Set its number in the circuit slot of the machine's screen; it is never used up.
gtia.quest.560B95AA0A068055.desc.2: EMI shows the circuit number every recipe needs.
gtia.quest.0A38C883A891E7F1.title: Coil Temperature
gtia.quest.0A38C883A891E7F1.subtitle: Hotter coils, more recipes.
gtia.quest.0A38C883A891E7F1.desc.0: The coils decide the Electric Blast Furnace's heat: &e1,800 K&r for Cupronickel, &e2,700 K&r for Kanthal, &e3,600 K&r for Nichrome. A recipe that needs more heat than you have will not start.
gtia.quest.0A38C883A891E7F1.desc.2: Heat above what a recipe needs makes it cheaper, and far above it, faster.
gtia.quest.38CA6D953B26F3B6.title: Ascend to Medium Voltage
gtia.quest.38CA6D953B26F3B6.subtitle: A better circuit and a lighter hull.
gtia.quest.38CA6D953B26F3B6.desc.0: Aluminium for the hull, silicon and silver for the circuit. Medium Voltage is waiting.
gtia.quest.504EF8C3140CAD5D.title: Medium Voltage Age
gtia.quest.504EF8C3140CAD5D.subtitle: Ascension III
gtia.quest.504EF8C3140CAD5D.desc.0: Medium Voltage is where the factory starts to look like an industry: silicon becomes chips, and the old processes of real chemistry plants arrive. Bauxite into aluminium, sulfur into acid, air into ammonia. This Ascension ends with an &6Advanced Integrated Circuit&r and an &6HV Machine Hull&r.
gtia.quest.5B8ECE2B3E043A46.title: MV Electric Motor
gtia.quest.5B8ECE2B3E043A46.subtitle: Aluminium rods, steel magnets.
gtia.quest.5B8ECE2B3E043A46.desc.0: Cupronickel coils around a magnetic steel rod. Every MV machine starts here.
gtia.quest.696C6F44421317F8.title: MV Electric Piston
gtia.quest.696C6F44421317F8.subtitle: Push harder.
gtia.quest.696C6F44421317F8.desc.0: An MV motor with aluminium plates. Lathes, Extruders and the MV Robot Arm need it.
gtia.quest.2645FEDF5ECBAF4E.title: MV Electric Pump
gtia.quest.2645FEDF5ECBAF4E.subtitle: Move more fluid.
gtia.quest.2645FEDF5ECBAF4E.desc.0: An MV motor, a bronze rotor and a steel pipe. The Chemical Bath and the Pyrolyse Oven use it.
gtia.quest.50EEE30ACD0D5165.title: MV Conveyor Module
gtia.quest.50EEE30ACD0D5165.subtitle: Move more items.
gtia.quest.50EEE30ACD0D5165.desc.0: Two MV motors and rubber. The MV Assembler, Cutter and Chemical Bath need it.
gtia.quest.4F35B2A2A14E1AB9.title: MV Robot Arm
gtia.quest.4F35B2A2A14E1AB9.subtitle: A steadier hand.
gtia.quest.4F35B2A2A14E1AB9.desc.0: Two MV motors, an MV piston and a good circuit. The MV Assembler needs two.
gtia.quest.5856F2D1648D61DE.title: Electrum Rods
gtia.quest.5856F2D1648D61DE.subtitle: Silver and gold.
gtia.quest.5856F2D1648D61DE.desc.0: Electrum, the alloy of silver and gold, made into rods. The MV Sensor and Emitter are framed with them.
gtia.quest.6D1F91AD527835FA.title: MV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.6D1F91AD527835FA.subtitle: 128 V from the same steam.
gtia.quest.6D1F91AD527835FA.desc.0: Your boilers again, at Medium Voltage. Or check Power Generation for combustion and gas.
gtia.quest.1B0581FFF976E579.title: MV Assembler
gtia.quest.1B0581FFF976E579.subtitle: Faster, and MV recipes.
gtia.quest.1B0581FFF976E579.desc.0: Transistors and integrated circuits need an MV Assembler.
gtia.quest.279278CBBD75789E.title: MV Mixer
gtia.quest.279278CBBD75789E.subtitle: Four ingredients at once.
gtia.quest.279278CBBD75789E.desc.0: Stainless Steel, Kanthal and Vanadium Steel dusts all need an MV Mixer.
gtia.quest.16E3D00500A5BB0B.title: MV Chemical Bath
gtia.quest.16E3D00500A5BB0B.subtitle: A cold bath for hot metal.
gtia.quest.16E3D00500A5BB0B.desc.0: Besides washing ores in chemicals, it quenches hot ingots in water: Kanthal comes out of the furnace too hot to touch.
gtia.quest.065411FD48701219.title: Kanthal
gtia.quest.065411FD48701219.subtitle: Iron, aluminium, chromium.
gtia.quest.065411FD48701219.desc.0: Mix iron, aluminium and chromium, then blast the dust. Kanthal wire is what the next coil is made of.
gtia.quest.5CCA3C01B051A1CF.title: Kanthal Coils
gtia.quest.5CCA3C01B051A1CF.subtitle: 2700 K.
gtia.quest.5CCA3C01B051A1CF.desc.0: Kanthal smelts hot in the Electric Blast Furnace; quench the hot ingot in the Chemical Bath, then wire it with Aluminium foil and copper. The furnace is ready for the hotter metals of High Voltage.
gtia.quest.5CCA3C01B051A1CF.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r Kanthal (iron, chromium, aluminium) was invented in Sweden in the 1930s and still heats most toasters on Earth.
gtia.quest.3EA592967D9E9E3F.title: Vanadium Steel
gtia.quest.3EA592967D9E9E3F.subtitle: Tough steel for blades.
gtia.quest.3EA592967D9E9E3F.desc.0: Vanadium, Chromium and Steel, mixed and smelted. The MV Cutter's saw blade is made of it.
gtia.quest.5090547B46FCE73D.title: MV Cutter
gtia.quest.5090547B46FCE73D.subtitle: Slices of silicon.
gtia.quest.5090547B46FCE73D.desc.0: A Vanadium Steel buzz saw. It cuts silicon boules into wafers and wafers into chips.
gtia.quest.6318999D0393E359.title: Extruder
gtia.quest.6318999D0393E359.subtitle: Shapes from a die.
gtia.quest.6318999D0393E359.desc.0: Plates, rods, pipes and more from one ingot and the right shape.
gtia.quest.52E80D9614D45259.title: MV Chemical Reactor
gtia.quest.52E80D9614D45259.subtitle: Hotter chemistry.
gtia.quest.52E80D9614D45259.desc.0: Cryolite, the Bayer line and the vanadium catalyst start here.
gtia.quest.3DA44F536F2625FA.title: MV Electrolyzer
gtia.quest.3DA44F536F2625FA.subtitle: Harder splits.
gtia.quest.3DA44F536F2625FA.desc.0: Mica, Lepidolite and Topaz give up their fluorine only at MV.
gtia.quest.4158F988E5A49BA4.title: MV Lathe
gtia.quest.4158F988E5A49BA4.subtitle: Lenses.
gtia.quest.4158F988E5A49BA4.desc.0: Turns exquisite gems into the lenses of the Laser Engraver.
gtia.quest.68F7AD3FF14593D4.title: Ore Washer
gtia.quest.68F7AD3FF14593D4.subtitle: Clean ore, more ore.
gtia.quest.68F7AD3FF14593D4.desc.0: Washing crushed ore gives purified ore and its first byproducts.
gtia.quest.250587E03F0576B8.title: Sifter
gtia.quest.250587E03F0576B8.subtitle: Grades your gems.
gtia.quest.250587E03F0576B8.desc.0: Purified gem ores through a Sifter come out as gems of every quality.
gtia.quest.2AB2176EAB4E58A3.title: LV Cutter
gtia.quest.2AB2176EAB4E58A3.subtitle: Plates from gems.
gtia.quest.2AB2176EAB4E58A3.desc.0: Cuts gem blocks into plates: Lazurite plates make fluid filters.
gtia.quest.667980415CD32F36.title: Flawless Emerald
gtia.quest.667980415CD32F36.subtitle: Sift for the good ones.
gtia.quest.667980415CD32F36.desc.0: A Sifter grades purified gem ores. The emitter needs a flawless emerald.
gtia.quest.6885D38E766965B4.title: MV Emitter
gtia.quest.6885D38E766965B4.subtitle: A focused beam.
gtia.quest.6885D38E766965B4.desc.0: The heart of the Laser Engraver.
gtia.quest.458C29C755A275C7.title: MV Sensor
gtia.quest.458C29C755A275C7.subtitle: A sharper eye.
gtia.quest.458C29C755A275C7.desc.0: A Flawless Emerald, an electrum rod, aluminium plates and a good circuit.
gtia.quest.5033C713FFFE6453.title: Laser Engraver
gtia.quest.5033C713FFFE6453.subtitle: Light that writes.
gtia.quest.5033C713FFFE6453.desc.0: With a lens, it prints circuits onto silicon wafers.
gtia.quest.051A7A471D165640.title: Lenses
gtia.quest.051A7A471D165640.subtitle: Red, green, blue.
gtia.quest.051A7A471D165640.desc.0: Ruby for logic, emerald for memory, sapphire for the power chips. Exquisite gems on the MV Lathe.
gtia.quest.28369DD5349AA123.title: ULPIC Chips
gtia.quest.28369DD5349AA123.subtitle: Power management on a chip.
gtia.quest.28369DD5349AA123.desc.0: A sapphire lens and a silicon wafer. MV Energy Hatches need them.
gtia.quest.6860F84D7172B7C0.title: MV Voltage Coil
gtia.quest.6860F84D7172B7C0.subtitle: A magnet, wound.
gtia.quest.6860F84D7172B7C0.desc.0: Fine copper wire around a magnetic steel rod.
gtia.quest.113D6C3E66EBCDC4.title: MV Energy Hatches
gtia.quest.113D6C3E66EBCDC4.subtitle: Two of them.
gtia.quest.113D6C3E66EBCDC4.desc.0: Two MV Energy Hatches push the Electric Blast Furnace to High Voltage recipes: Stainless Steel and Kanthal.
gtia.quest.1BCFA3BDB989211E.title: Stainless Steel
gtia.quest.1BCFA3BDB989211E.subtitle: Iron that does not rust.
gtia.quest.1BCFA3BDB989211E.desc.0: Iron, Nickel, Manganese and Chromium, mixed and smelted in the Electric Blast Furnace at MV.
gtia.quest.1BCFA3BDB989211E.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r stainless steel was found in 1913 by Harry Brearley, looking for a better gun barrel. He got cutlery instead.
gtia.quest.026E490AA8A54AF6.title: Silicon Boule
gtia.quest.026E490AA8A54AF6.subtitle: One big crystal.
gtia.quest.026E490AA8A54AF6.desc.0: Silicon dust and a pinch of Gallium Arsenide, grown in the Electric Blast Furnace.
gtia.quest.026E490AA8A54AF6.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r this is the Czochralski process, from 1916; Jan Czochralski found it by dipping his pen into molten tin instead of the inkwell.
gtia.quest.2D7B8E89436888F6.title: Silicon Wafers
gtia.quest.2D7B8E89436888F6.subtitle: Sliced thin.
gtia.quest.2D7B8E89436888F6.desc.0: One boule, many wafers. Everything electronic from now on starts as one of these.
gtia.quest.2A555A4FBDABFF70.title: Integrated Logic Circuits
gtia.quest.2A555A4FBDABFF70.subtitle: The first chips.
gtia.quest.2A555A4FBDABFF70.desc.0: Engrave a wafer with a red lens and cut it into chips.
gtia.quest.5AE004D0EBF12D31.title: RAM Chips
gtia.quest.5AE004D0EBF12D31.subtitle: Memory.
gtia.quest.5AE004D0EBF12D31.desc.0: A different lens, a different chip.
gtia.quest.497B83134062A1F3.title: Transistors
gtia.quest.497B83134062A1F3.subtitle: The switch that changed everything.
gtia.quest.497B83134062A1F3.desc.0: Silicon, fine tin wire and polyethylene.
gtia.quest.497B83134062A1F3.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r the first transistor (Bell Labs, 1947) was a lump of germanium with two gold contacts held on by a paperclip.
gtia.quest.5A436C6D4DEA53EC.title: Basic Integrated Circuit
gtia.quest.5A436C6D4DEA53EC.subtitle: A circuit on a chip.
gtia.quest.5A436C6D4DEA53EC.desc.0: A resin board, an ILC chip, resistors and diodes.
gtia.quest.080AD3BD18BF385F.title: Good Integrated Circuit
gtia.quest.080AD3BD18BF385F.subtitle: Two become one.
gtia.quest.080AD3BD18BF385F.desc.0: Two basic integrated circuits on a phenolic board, with gold wire and silver bolts.
gtia.quest.431A285F135D870A.title: Arc Furnace
gtia.quest.431A285F135D870A.subtitle: Lightning in a box.
gtia.quest.431A285F135D870A.desc.0: Melts metal with an electric arc. With Oxygen, copper comes out annealed; it also recycles old machines into ingots.
gtia.quest.26D50B16FF390132.title: Annealed Copper
gtia.quest.26D50B16FF390132.subtitle: Softer copper, better wire.
gtia.quest.26D50B16FF390132.desc.0: Copper through the Arc Furnace with Oxygen from your air separation.
gtia.quest.7FFDD6C6357E1A46.title: Advanced Integrated Circuit
gtia.quest.7FFDD6C6357E1A46.subtitle: The HV circuit.
gtia.quest.7FFDD6C6357E1A46.desc.0: Two good integrated circuits, ILC and RAM chips, transistors, electrum wire and annealed copper bolts.
gtia.quest.4038D5A4305BB335.title: Stainless Steel Plates
gtia.quest.4038D5A4305BB335.subtitle: Nine plates.
gtia.quest.4038D5A4305BB335.desc.0: Eight for the casing and one for the hull.
gtia.quest.079EEE28B8E29B84.title: HV Machine Casing
gtia.quest.079EEE28B8E29B84.subtitle: Eight Stainless Steel Plates.
gtia.quest.079EEE28B8E29B84.desc.0: The shell of every High Voltage machine.
gtia.quest.2A5AE184AEE54737.title: Gold Cable
gtia.quest.2A5AE184AEE54737.subtitle: HV needs gold.
gtia.quest.07C6486B77AD2972.title: Polyethylene Plates
gtia.quest.07C6486B77AD2972.subtitle: Plastic, finally useful.
gtia.quest.07C6486B77AD2972.desc.0: Solidify the Polyethylene from your LV line into plates.
gtia.quest.6904837F2ACA3A37.title: HV Machine Hull
gtia.quest.6904837F2ACA3A37.subtitle: The body of every HV machine.
gtia.quest.6904837F2ACA3A37.desc.0: Casing, two Gold Cables, two Polyethylene Plates and a Stainless Steel Plate.
gtia.quest.53FEE3DE0FB95AF5.title: Bayer Process
gtia.quest.53FEE3DE0FB95AF5.subtitle: Bauxite in hot caustic soda.
gtia.quest.53FEE3DE0FB95AF5.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, &e1 Bauxite&r, &e1 Sodium Hydroxide&r, water and steam become &e1,000 mB&r of Sodium Aluminate, leaving red mud. A seed of Aluminium Hydroxide then precipitates it into &e2 Aluminium Hydroxide&r and gives back most of the soda.
gtia.quest.53FEE3DE0FB95AF5.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r Karl Josef Bayer patented the process in 1888. Nearly all the world's alumina is still made this way.
gtia.quest.3C3CB2122CD34909.title: Alumina
gtia.quest.3C3CB2122CD34909.subtitle: Calcined in the Coke Oven.
gtia.quest.3C3CB2122CD34909.desc.0: Your old Coke Oven calcines &e2 Aluminium Hydroxide&r into &e1 Alumina&r. The Steam Age is still working for you.
gtia.quest.4E4B848A1FA81753.title: Cryolite
gtia.quest.4E4B848A1FA81753.subtitle: The molten bath.
gtia.quest.4E4B848A1FA81753.desc.0: Aluminium Hydroxide, Sodium Hydroxide and Hydrofluoric Acid in a Chemical Reactor. Alumina dissolves in it at a much lower temperature.
gtia.quest.754D2ACD373583C8.title: Carbon Anode
gtia.quest.754D2ACD373583C8.subtitle: Coke and tar.
gtia.quest.754D2ACD373583C8.desc.0: Coke dust bound with Wood Tar in a Mixer. It burns away in the cell, one per run.
gtia.quest.67175118C46ADF68.title: Hall-Héroult
