gtia.quest.67175118C46ADF68.subtitle: Aluminium the real way.
gtia.quest.67175118C46ADF68.desc.0: In the &6Electric Blast Furnace&r at &e1,233 K&r, &e2 Alumina&r and a Carbon Anode become &e4 Aluminium Ingots&r and CO₂, with a small chance to use up the cryolite bath. Twice what alumina and plain carbon give.
gtia.quest.67175118C46ADF68.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r Charles Hall and Paul Héroult found the same process in 1886, independently, on two continents. Both were 22.
gtia.quest.491EA78EB371D651.title: Gas Collector
gtia.quest.491EA78EB371D651.subtitle: Bottled air.
gtia.quest.491EA78EB371D651.desc.0: It pulls Air from the world around it. Its fluid filter is a Lazurite plate.
gtia.quest.0623071762390A9E.title: Nitrogen
gtia.quest.0623071762390A9E.subtitle: Four fifths of the air.
gtia.quest.0623071762390A9E.desc.0: A Centrifuge splits Air into Nitrogen and Oxygen.
gtia.quest.174F3AD8908B1D3D.title: Hydrofluoric Acid
gtia.quest.174F3AD8908B1D3D.subtitle: Handle with care.
gtia.quest.174F3AD8908B1D3D.desc.0: Fluorine from Mica or Lepidolite in the MV Electrolyzer, burnt with Hydrogen into Hydrofluoric Acid.
gtia.quest.1EA9675F5B507531.title: Vanadium Pentoxide
gtia.quest.1EA9675F5B507531.subtitle: The catalyst.
gtia.quest.1EA9675F5B507531.desc.0: Vanadium dust burnt in oxygen. It is never used up.
gtia.quest.7C9302B22901B3EC.title: Contact Process
gtia.quest.7C9302B22901B3EC.subtitle: Sulfur into acid, and steam for free.
gtia.quest.7C9302B22901B3EC.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r: sulfur, oxygen and water over Vanadium Pentoxide give &e1,000 mB&r of Sulfuric Acid and &e2,000 mB&r of steam per run. The reaction is hot enough to feed your turbines.
gtia.quest.7C9302B22901B3EC.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r sulfuric acid is the most produced chemical in the world; economists once used it to measure how industrial a country was.
gtia.quest.0B0DFAAC23E69912.title: Haber-Bosch
gtia.quest.0B0DFAAC23E69912.subtitle: Bread from air.
gtia.quest.0B0DFAAC23E69912.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, Nitrogen and Hydrogen over an iron (Magnetite) catalyst become Ammonia, with a little steam. Your chlor-alkali Electrolyzer already makes the hydrogen.
gtia.quest.0B0DFAAC23E69912.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r the Haber-Bosch process feeds about half of humanity: most of the nitrogen in your body passed through one.
gtia.quest.0D8B6A761A3480E0.title: Solvay Process
gtia.quest.0D8B6A761A3480E0.subtitle: Soda from salt and lime.
gtia.quest.0D8B6A761A3480E0.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, brine, Ammonia and CO₂ give Sodium Bicarbonate and Ammonium Chloride. The Coke Oven calcines the bicarbonate into Soda Ash, and Quicklime gets the ammonia back.
gtia.quest.0D8B6A761A3480E0.desc.2: &aReal fact:&r Ernest Solvay's process (1861) made soda ash so cheap that glass windows became normal houses' business.
gtia.quest.69150765E99F67F2.title: Sulfuric Acid
gtia.quest.69150765E99F67F2.subtitle: The most useful acid.
gtia.quest.69150765E99F67F2.desc.0: From now on, make it in bulk.
gtia.quest.3EB8DF95318F1354.title: Ammonia
gtia.quest.3EB8DF95318F1354.subtitle: Bread from air, by the bucket.
gtia.quest.3EB8DF95318F1354.desc.0: Fertiliser, explosives, rocket fuel, and the Solvay process.
gtia.quest.102F7E1E812EEB90.title: Soda Ash
gtia.quest.102F7E1E812EEB90.subtitle: Calcined bicarbonate.
gtia.quest.102F7E1E812EEB90.desc.0: Sodium Bicarbonate from the Solvay process, calcined in your Coke Oven.
gtia.quest.5AA47704DF2B114A.title: Pyrolyse Oven
gtia.quest.5AA47704DF2B114A.subtitle: The Coke Oven, grown up.
gtia.quest.5AA47704DF2B114A.desc.0: Logs and nitrogen in, charcoal and far more byproducts out. The efficient route for your wood chemistry.
gtia.quest.332697480439D566.title: Distillery
gtia.quest.332697480439D566.subtitle: The LV Distillery, grown up.
gtia.quest.332697480439D566.desc.0: Much more Methanol and Acetic Acid from the same Wood Vinegar.
gtia.quest.52BA60C2A0378DFA.title: Autocrafting
gtia.quest.52BA60C2A0378DFA.subtitle: The network starts working for you.
gtia.quest.52BA60C2A0378DFA.desc.0: Pattern Providers, Molecular Assemblers and Crafting Units. Teach the network a recipe once and it makes it forever.
gtia.quest.0E02FEAC26E15F37.title: Greenhouse
gtia.quest.0E02FEAC26E15F37.subtitle: Crops on a conveyor.
gtia.quest.0E02FEAC26E15F37.desc.0: A GTNA multiblock that grows plants for your Brewery and wood lines.
gtia.quest.57B969C5B4639C64.title: Vinyl Chloride
gtia.quest.57B969C5B4639C64.subtitle: Ethylene meets chlorine.
gtia.quest.57B969C5B4639C64.desc.0: Ethylene from the ethanol dehydration and chlorine from the chlor-alkali Electrolyzer, in the Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.4B254B8464F27DF7.title: Polyvinyl Chloride
gtia.quest.4B254B8464F27DF7.subtitle: A harder plastic.
gtia.quest.4B254B8464F27DF7.desc.0: Vinyl chloride and oxygen make PVC. Its plates are the base of the plastic circuit board.
gtia.quest.48E803C3A5837BED.title: Plastic Circuit Board
gtia.quest.48E803C3A5837BED.subtitle: PVC, copper and acid.
gtia.quest.48E803C3A5837BED.desc.0: A PVC plate, copper foil and sulfuric acid in the Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.6FB0B68EE45D1558.title: Plastic Printed Circuit Board
gtia.quest.6FB0B68EE45D1558.subtitle: Etched with iron chloride.
gtia.quest.6FB0B68EE45D1558.desc.0: Etch the plastic board with copper foil and iron(III) chloride. Microprocessors are built on it.
gtia.quest.078816FCAF910C95.title: Diamond Lens
gtia.quest.078816FCAF910C95.subtitle: Turn it on the lathe.
gtia.quest.078816FCAF910C95.desc.0: An exquisite diamond on the MV Lathe. The laser engraver uses it to draw CPUs.
gtia.quest.18177A9D141442BD.title: CPU Wafer
gtia.quest.18177A9D141442BD.subtitle: Draw the processor.
gtia.quest.18177A9D141442BD.desc.0: Engrave a silicon wafer through the diamond lens in the MV Laser Engraver.
gtia.quest.208505FAC95F648B.title: CPU Chip
gtia.quest.208505FAC95F648B.subtitle: Cut it free.
gtia.quest.208505FAC95F648B.desc.0: Cut the CPU wafer in the MV Cutter. Each chip becomes the heart of a Microprocessor in High Voltage.
gtia.quest.7DC9DE30EE29CB8C.title: Ostwald Process
gtia.quest.7DC9DE30EE29CB8C.subtitle: Ammonia into nitric acid.
gtia.quest.7DC9DE30EE29CB8C.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r: circuit 1 burns your &6Ammonia&r over a &6Cobalt Oxide&r gauze, circuit 2 oxidizes the gas and circuit 3 absorbs it in water. A third of the gas comes back for another round, like in every real plant.
gtia.quest.4532CBAE5FB845C4.title: Nitric Acid
gtia.quest.4532CBAE5FB845C4.subtitle: Two thirds per pass.
gtia.quest.4532CBAE5FB845C4.desc.0: Circuit 1 burns, circuit 2 oxidizes, circuit 3 absorbs. With the Moon's platinum, circuit 4 burns faster and gives twice the steam.
gtia.quest.7D535EC0FB46B006.title: Overclocking
gtia.quest.7D535EC0FB46B006.subtitle: Old recipes, new speed.
gtia.quest.7D535EC0FB46B006.desc.0: A recipe from a lower tier runs faster in a machine of a higher one: each tier above halves the time and takes four times the power.
gtia.quest.7D535EC0FB46B006.desc.2: Your LV recipes in MV machines take half the time. Worth it for the slow ones.
gtia.quest.542BA5EE71214DDD.title: Maintenance
gtia.quest.542BA5EE71214DDD.subtitle: Normal worlds only.
gtia.quest.542BA5EE71214DDD.desc.0: In &6Normal&r worlds every multiblock needs a &6Maintenance Hatch&r. Problems show up over time and slow the machine down; click the hatch with the tools it asks for to fix them. Later hatches fix themselves.
gtia.quest.546CCE3DDBC40428.title: Batch Mode
gtia.quest.546CCE3DDBC40428.subtitle: Many short runs as one.
gtia.quest.546CCE3DDBC40428.desc.0: Very short recipes lose time between runs. The &6Batch Mode&r button in a multiblock controller's screen groups several runs into one longer run. The EBF and the Large Chemical Reactor support it.
gtia.quest.65075BFD98BEAF73.title: Ascend to High Voltage
gtia.quest.65075BFD98BEAF73.subtitle: Stainless steel and a chip that thinks.
gtia.quest.65075BFD98BEAF73.desc.0: Integrated circuits, stainless steel and Kanthal coils. High Voltage is next.
gtia.quest.31AF3AD2C78D4901.title: High Voltage Age
gtia.quest.31AF3AD2C78D4901.subtitle: Ascension IV
gtia.quest.31AF3AD2C78D4901.desc.0: High Voltage opens chemistry: distillation, cracking, plastics and the Cleanroom. Nichrome and Titanium raise your furnace ceiling.
gtia.quest.1EA40DE258CB0D37.title: High Voltage Age
gtia.quest.1EA40DE258CB0D37.subtitle: The frame of High Voltage.
gtia.quest.1EA40DE258CB0D37.desc.0: The HV Machine Hull: stainless steel casing, gold cables and polyethylene. The Advanced Integrated Circuit from the end of MV is your HV circuit.
gtia.quest.667FD8A52B98CABC.title: HV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.667FD8A52B98CABC.subtitle: Power for High Voltage.
gtia.quest.667FD8A52B98CABC.desc.0: Two HV motors, stainless pipes and rotors. Every 480 EU/t machine in this chapter runs on HV power.
gtia.quest.60A92015EBCDF3AA.title: HV Electric Motor
gtia.quest.60A92015EBCDF3AA.subtitle: Stainless steel and silver.
gtia.quest.60A92015EBCDF3AA.desc.0: Stainless steel rods, a magnetic steel rod, electrum wire and silver cables. Every HV part starts here.
gtia.quest.3A28137F2C526113.title: HV Electric Pump
gtia.quest.3A28137F2C526113.subtitle: Move fluids at HV.
gtia.quest.3A28137F2C526113.desc.0: An HV motor with a stainless steel pipe and rubber rings. The Vacuum Freezer and the Distillation Tower need it.
gtia.quest.3BDC45EDEE04CD6A.title: HV Electric Piston
gtia.quest.3BDC45EDEE04CD6A.subtitle: Push at HV.
gtia.quest.3BDC45EDEE04CD6A.desc.0: An HV motor, stainless plates, rods and a small gear.
gtia.quest.258FE722ABF6F9E0.title: HV Robot Arm
gtia.quest.258FE722ABF6F9E0.subtitle: The HV hand.
gtia.quest.258FE722ABF6F9E0.desc.0: Two HV motors, an HV piston and an HV circuit. The HV Assembler needs two.
gtia.quest.66C0E029CEDA91CB.title: HV Conveyor Module
gtia.quest.66C0E029CEDA91CB.subtitle: Rubber is not enough anymore.
gtia.quest.66C0E029CEDA91CB.desc.0: Two HV motors and silicone rubber (or styrene-butadiene rubber). Plain rubber no longer works here.
gtia.quest.1CBB0DE275C91AE9.title: Eye of Ender
gtia.quest.1CBB0DE275C91AE9.subtitle: The eye of HV sensors.
gtia.quest.1CBB0DE275C91AE9.desc.0: Ender Pearl and Blaze Powder. The HV Sensor and Emitter look through it.
gtia.quest.2EA77B3FAAF5B532.title: Chromium
gtia.quest.2EA77B3FAAF5B532.subtitle: From chromite.
gtia.quest.2EA77B3FAAF5B532.desc.0: Chromium dust from chromite, blasted into ingots and turned into rods.
gtia.quest.3C748EBFCDA9FBE3.title: HV Sensor
gtia.quest.3C748EBFCDA9FBE3.subtitle: Sees farther.
gtia.quest.3C748EBFCDA9FBE3.desc.0: An Eye of Ender, a chromium rod, stainless plates and an HV circuit.
gtia.quest.25498C9A9F1CC36E.title: HV Emitter
gtia.quest.25498C9A9F1CC36E.subtitle: Sends farther.
gtia.quest.25498C9A9F1CC36E.desc.0: Chromium rods around an Eye of Ender. The HV Laser Engraver and Circuit Assembler need it.
gtia.quest.3B22606F3DAB9A7D.title: Stainless Steel Parts
gtia.quest.3B22606F3DAB9A7D.subtitle: Rotors and screws.
gtia.quest.3B22606F3DAB9A7D.desc.0: Stainless steel rotors go into the Cleanroom and the Large Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.0D0D7FCC02F10731.title: HV Mixer
gtia.quest.0D0D7FCC02F10731.subtitle: Optional: faster, not required.
gtia.quest.0D0D7FCC02F10731.desc.0: Nothing in High Voltage needs the HV Mixer. Build it when your lines want more speed.
gtia.quest.130D7D77B789128A.title: HV Centrifuge
gtia.quest.130D7D77B789128A.subtitle: Optional: faster, not required.
gtia.quest.130D7D77B789128A.desc.0: Nothing in High Voltage needs the HV Centrifuge. Build it when your lines want more speed.
gtia.quest.572B955765C8B597.title: HV Electrolyzer
gtia.quest.572B955765C8B597.subtitle: Optional: faster, not required.
gtia.quest.572B955765C8B597.desc.0: Nothing in High Voltage needs the HV Electrolyzer. Build it when your lines want more speed.
gtia.quest.4DA7C1D3E93BD14D.title: HV Extruder
gtia.quest.4DA7C1D3E93BD14D.subtitle: Optional: faster, not required.
gtia.quest.4DA7C1D3E93BD14D.desc.0: Nothing in High Voltage needs the HV Extruder. Build it when your lines want more speed.
gtia.quest.2F05F1A7B2AFEF30.title: HV Macerator
gtia.quest.2F05F1A7B2AFEF30.subtitle: Optional: faster, not required.
gtia.quest.2F05F1A7B2AFEF30.desc.0: Nothing in High Voltage needs the HV Macerator. Build it when your lines want more speed.
gtia.quest.73573A54C54711E0.title: Chloromethane
gtia.quest.73573A54C54711E0.subtitle: Methane meets chlorine.
gtia.quest.73573A54C54711E0.desc.0: Chlorine and methane in the Chemical Reactor. It starts the silicone line.
gtia.quest.11D0F258727C8B2E.title: Dimethyldichlorosilane
gtia.quest.11D0F258727C8B2E.subtitle: The Müller-Rochow step.
gtia.quest.11D0F258727C8B2E.desc.0: Silicon dust and chloromethane. Water turns it into polydimethylsiloxane.
gtia.quest.003F11B9A95741A7.title: Polydimethylsiloxane
gtia.quest.003F11B9A95741A7.subtitle: Raw silicone.
gtia.quest.003F11B9A95741A7.desc.0: From dimethyldichlorosilane and water, or straight from silicon, HCl and methanol.
gtia.quest.6F7EF67C1C841C60.title: Silicone Rubber
gtia.quest.6F7EF67C1C841C60.subtitle: Vulcanized with sulfur.
gtia.quest.6F7EF67C1C841C60.desc.0: Nine PDMS and one sulfur. HV conveyors, pump rings and SMD capacitors use it.
gtia.quest.0BF30866F9B0CEBA.title: HV Assembler
gtia.quest.0BF30866F9B0CEBA.subtitle: Needed: 480 EU/t parts.
gtia.quest.0BF30866F9B0CEBA.desc.0: SMD components, the HV Energy Hatch and the Nichrome coil only assemble at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.783F3BDA7A5E1F30.title: Red Steel
gtia.quest.783F3BDA7A5E1F30.subtitle: A blade for HV.
gtia.quest.783F3BDA7A5E1F30.desc.0: Rose gold, brass, black steel and steel, mixed and blasted. Its buzzsaw blade goes into the HV Cutter.
gtia.quest.4D55ED2AB026782F.title: HV Cutter
gtia.quest.4D55ED2AB026782F.subtitle: Needed: wafers and chips.
gtia.quest.4D55ED2AB026782F.desc.0: Phosphorus wafers, LPIC and NOR/NAND chips are cut at 480 and 192 EU/t, inside the Cleanroom.
gtia.quest.13BDD6640287AEC9.title: HV Chemical Bath
gtia.quest.13BDD6640287AEC9.subtitle: Needed: dyed lenses.
gtia.quest.13BDD6640287AEC9.desc.0: Glass lenses are dyed at 480 EU/t: orange for LPIC, pink for NOR, gray for NAND.
gtia.quest.2CB52F62E8DC7FB2.title: HV Laser Engraver
gtia.quest.2CB52F62E8DC7FB2.subtitle: Needed: memory wafers.
gtia.quest.2CB52F62E8DC7FB2.desc.0: NOR and NAND patterns are engraved on the phosphorus wafer at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.069EED1B702CDEF4.title: HV Chemical Reactor
gtia.quest.069EED1B702CDEF4.subtitle: Needed: HV chemistry.
gtia.quest.069EED1B702CDEF4.desc.0: Tetrafluoroethylene (240 EU/t) and dimethylhydrazine (480 EU/t) do not run in the MV reactor.
gtia.quest.5E25EA51925C4682.title: Cleanroom
gtia.quest.5E25EA51925C4682.subtitle: A sealed room with filtered air.
gtia.quest.5E25EA51925C4682.desc.0: Circuits above the first tiers need a clean room: a sealed room with filtered air.
gtia.quest.35403C9D242FE299.title: MV Circuit Assembler
gtia.quest.35403C9D242FE299.subtitle: The microprocessor runs at 60 EU/t.
gtia.quest.35403C9D242FE299.desc.0: The LV Circuit Assembler stops at 32 EU/t. The microprocessor, the first step of the HV circuit ladder, needs this one.
gtia.quest.38CD02F1C14F6100.title: Microprocessor
gtia.quest.38CD02F1C14F6100.subtitle: A cheap LV circuit.
gtia.quest.38CD02F1C14F6100.desc.0: A CPU chip on a plastic printed board with small parts. Two of them make a Processor Assembly.
gtia.quest.79F8217F80D5BE3B.title: Processor Assembly
gtia.quest.79F8217F80D5BE3B.subtitle: A cheaper HV circuit.
gtia.quest.79F8217F80D5BE3B.desc.0: Two microprocessors with inductors, capacitors and RAM. An HV circuit cheaper than the Advanced Integrated one.
gtia.quest.18C228E5FFC89549.title: Workstation
gtia.quest.18C228E5FFC89549.subtitle: Your first EV circuit.
gtia.quest.18C228E5FFC89549.desc.0: Two Processor Assemblies, made in the Cleanroom. The Vacuum Freezer, the Distillation Tower and the HV Circuit Assembler need it.
gtia.quest.5FFD2A570E27CB6D.title: HV Circuit Assembler
gtia.quest.5FFD2A570E27CB6D.subtitle: Needed: the Mainframe.
gtia.quest.5FFD2A570E27CB6D.desc.0: The Mainframe only assembles at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.5578AF091742FA61.title: Mainframe
gtia.quest.5578AF091742FA61.subtitle: Your first IV circuit.
gtia.quest.5578AF091742FA61.desc.0: Two Workstations, aluminium frames, RAM, inductors and capacitors at 480 EU/t. Insane Voltage starts here.
gtia.quest.2FA7EB1C2E1C93FC.title: Dyed Glass Lenses
gtia.quest.2FA7EB1C2E1C93FC.subtitle: Orange, pink and gray.
gtia.quest.2FA7EB1C2E1C93FC.desc.0: Glass lenses dyed in the HV Chemical Bath. Each colour engraves a different chip.
gtia.quest.466A24D13A7597E8.title: Low Power IC
gtia.quest.466A24D13A7597E8.subtitle: Inside every HV hatch.
gtia.quest.466A24D13A7597E8.desc.0: A silicon wafer engraved with the orange lens and cut in the Cleanroom.
gtia.quest.29F70E7B016EB028.title: Sodium-Potassium
gtia.quest.29F70E7B016EB028.subtitle: A liquid metal coolant.
gtia.quest.29F70E7B016EB028.desc.0: Sodium and potassium dust make NaK. The HV Energy Hatch is filled with it.
gtia.quest.2C2D9D114771E326.title: HV Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.2C2D9D114771E326.subtitle: Power for HV multiblocks.
gtia.quest.2C2D9D114771E326.desc.0: Two LPIC chips, an HV voltage coil and NaK. Your Blast Furnace can now run 480 EU/t recipes.
gtia.quest.1BD8A895E0DCA3C6.title: Two Hatches, One Tier Up
gtia.quest.1BD8A895E0DCA3C6.subtitle: Tip: EV recipes at HV.
gtia.quest.1BD8A895E0DCA3C6.desc.0: Two HV Energy Hatches on the same multiblock let it run 1,920 EU/t recipes, one tier above.
gtia.quest.379EBF258F06316C.title: Nichrome Smelting
gtia.quest.379EBF258F06316C.subtitle: Raises the furnace ceiling.
gtia.quest.379EBF258F06316C.desc.0: Nichrome makes the hottest coil in the tier. Smelting it needs a Kanthal-coil furnace at 2700 K.
gtia.quest.2F7329C1A689F9D9.title: Nichrome Coil Block
gtia.quest.2F7329C1A689F9D9.subtitle: Raise the furnace ceiling.
gtia.quest.2F7329C1A689F9D9.desc.0: Nichrome wire and stainless foil, assembled at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.758EEDD1932BD39C.title: Phosphorus-Doped Boule
gtia.quest.758EEDD1932BD39C.subtitle: Silicon with phosphorus.
gtia.quest.758EEDD1932BD39C.desc.0: Silicon, phosphorus and gallium arsenide in the Blast Furnace at 480 EU/t: it needs the HV Energy Hatch.
gtia.quest.298247C092A39D0F.title: Phosphorus-Doped Wafer
gtia.quest.298247C092A39D0F.subtitle: Slice the boule.
gtia.quest.298247C092A39D0F.desc.0: Cut the boule in the HV Cutter, inside the Cleanroom.
gtia.quest.446FA865FF0AECF3.title: NOR Memory Chips
gtia.quest.446FA865FF0AECF3.subtitle: Fast memory.
gtia.quest.446FA865FF0AECF3.desc.0: Engrave the phosphorus wafer with the pink lens, then cut it.
gtia.quest.430441272D59936E.title: NAND Memory Chips
gtia.quest.430441272D59936E.subtitle: Dense memory.
gtia.quest.430441272D59936E.desc.0: Engrave the phosphorus wafer with the gray lens, then cut it. Data Sticks are made from them.
gtia.quest.26B40081B38D7BB4.title: Data Stick
gtia.quest.26B40081B38D7BB4.subtitle: Store research.
gtia.quest.26B40081B38D7BB4.desc.0: Made in the Circuit Assembler inside the Cleanroom, with NAND chips.
gtia.quest.17D245D6925D851C.title: SMD Resistor
gtia.quest.17D245D6925D851C.subtitle: Small parts, better circuits.
gtia.quest.17D245D6925D851C.desc.0: Made from carbon and fine electrum wire in polyethylene, in the HV Assembler at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.64E5BC67F8EC4512.title: SMD Transistor
gtia.quest.64E5BC67F8EC4512.subtitle: Small parts, better circuits.
gtia.quest.64E5BC67F8EC4512.desc.0: Made from gallium foil and fine tantalum wire in polyethylene, in the HV Assembler at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.50949E9300453A2F.title: SMD Capacitor
gtia.quest.50949E9300453A2F.subtitle: Small parts, better circuits.
gtia.quest.50949E9300453A2F.desc.0: Made from silicone rubber foil and aluminium foil in polyethylene, in the HV Assembler at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.3E893E65F1BF44E2.title: SMD Inductor
gtia.quest.3E893E65F1BF44E2.subtitle: Small parts, better circuits.
gtia.quest.3E893E65F1BF44E2.desc.0: Made from a nickel-zinc ferrite ring and fine wire in polyethylene, in the HV Assembler at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.7313A5B0CDA56AB3.title: SMD Diode
gtia.quest.7313A5B0CDA56AB3.subtitle: Small parts, better circuits.
gtia.quest.7313A5B0CDA56AB3.desc.0: Made from gallium arsenide and fine platinum wire in polyethylene, in the HV Assembler at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.365628E1E05E7D94.title: Vacuum Freezer
gtia.quest.365628E1E05E7D94.subtitle: Cools hot ingots.
gtia.quest.365628E1E05E7D94.desc.0: The Vacuum Freezer cools the hot ingots that come out of the blast furnace into their normal form.
gtia.quest.1D99D4186B3360A6.title: Oil
gtia.quest.1D99D4186B3360A6.subtitle: Black gold.
gtia.quest.1D99D4186B3360A6.desc.0: Oil from the Fluid Drilling Rig, oil sands or soul sand in the centrifuge.
gtia.quest.09AEB1FD9B3D1AF2.title: Distillation Tower
gtia.quest.09AEB1FD9B3D1AF2.subtitle: Splits fluids into fractions.
gtia.quest.09AEB1FD9B3D1AF2.desc.0: Four Workstations, two HV pumps and large stainless pipes. Petrochemistry starts here.
gtia.quest.488D5A421F96844C.title: Oil Fractions
gtia.quest.488D5A421F96844C.subtitle: Naphtha and fuels.
gtia.quest.488D5A421F96844C.desc.0: Oil splits into sulfuric naphtha, light and heavy fuels and refinery gas.
gtia.quest.1D13396B916A742C.title: Desulfurization
gtia.quest.1D13396B916A742C.subtitle: Take the sulfur out.
gtia.quest.1D13396B916A742C.desc.0: Sulfuric fractions plus hydrogen give clean fractions and hydrogen sulfide, which goes back to sulfuric acid.
gtia.quest.165BAE6D86A18898.title: Cracker
gtia.quest.165BAE6D86A18898.subtitle: Breaks long hydrocarbons into lighter ones.
gtia.quest.165BAE6D86A18898.desc.0: The Cracker breaks long hydrocarbons into lighter ones using hydrogen or steam.
gtia.quest.07C22FB737FD8E96.title: Diesel and Gasoline
gtia.quest.07C22FB737FD8E96.subtitle: Bridge: power.
gtia.quest.07C22FB737FD8E96.desc.0: Light and heavy fuels mix into diesel for the combustion generators. See the energy chapter.
gtia.quest.268FE566AB5FD274.title: Ethylene and Propene
gtia.quest.268FE566AB5FD274.subtitle: From cracked naphtha.
gtia.quest.268FE566AB5FD274.desc.0: Distill steam-cracked naphtha: ethylene, propene, butadiene, benzene, toluene.
gtia.quest.7BC956E3323D35E6.title: Butadiene
gtia.quest.7BC956E3323D35E6.subtitle: Half of SBR.
gtia.quest.7BC956E3323D35E6.desc.0: From cracked naphtha. With styrene it becomes styrene-butadiene rubber.
gtia.quest.44D5721F04D0FE80.title: Benzene
gtia.quest.44D5721F04D0FE80.subtitle: The aromatic ring.
gtia.quest.44D5721F04D0FE80.desc.0: From cracked naphtha. Styrene, phenol and epoxy all start from it.
gtia.quest.59FD141BFF41220E.title: Styrene
gtia.quest.59FD141BFF41220E.subtitle: Ethylene plus benzene.
gtia.quest.59FD141BFF41220E.desc.0: Ethylene and benzene in the Chemical Reactor, or ethylbenzene from coal gas.
gtia.quest.59B9DF3753A4C8A2.title: Raw Styrene-Butadiene Rubber
gtia.quest.59B9DF3753A4C8A2.subtitle: Polymerize it.
gtia.quest.59B9DF3753A4C8A2.desc.0: Butadiene, styrene and air in the Large Chemical Reactor at 240 EU/t.
gtia.quest.677C72B053E15261.title: Styrene-Butadiene Rubber
gtia.quest.677C72B053E15261.subtitle: The other HV rubber.
gtia.quest.677C72B053E15261.desc.0: Vulcanize raw SBR with sulfur. It can replace silicone in HV conveyors.
gtia.quest.5A1A7C1D421227FD.title: Chloroform
gtia.quest.5A1A7C1D421227FD.subtitle: Methane, fully chlorinated.
gtia.quest.5A1A7C1D421227FD.desc.0: Six buckets of chlorine and one of methane in the Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.28DF423AEC57D0C9.title: Tetrafluoroethylene
gtia.quest.28DF423AEC57D0C9.subtitle: Needs the HV reactor.
gtia.quest.28DF423AEC57D0C9.desc.0: Chloroform and hydrofluoric acid at 240 EU/t.
gtia.quest.727416056B57EA7C.title: PTFE
gtia.quest.727416056B57EA7C.subtitle: A chemically inert plastic.
gtia.quest.727416056B57EA7C.desc.0: PTFE is a chemically inert plastic. Making it takes a Large Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.520885F018D114E2.title: PTFE Pipe Casing
gtia.quest.520885F018D114E2.subtitle: The walls of the big reactor.
gtia.quest.520885F018D114E2.desc.0: PTFE plates, pipes and a frame. The Large Chemical Reactor is built from it.
gtia.quest.6301DD637429E34F.title: Large Chemical Reactor
gtia.quest.6301DD637429E34F.subtitle: Chemistry in parallel.
gtia.quest.6301DD637429E34F.desc.0: PTFE pipes, a stainless rotor, an HV motor and four HV circuits.
gtia.quest.22A15300F7AD8AFC.title: Phenol and Acetone
gtia.quest.22A15300F7AD8AFC.subtitle: From cumene.
gtia.quest.22A15300F7AD8AFC.desc.0: Cumene and oxygen give phenol and acetone; benzene, chlorine and water is the other way.
gtia.quest.201BB139DCA98427.title: Epichlorohydrin
gtia.quest.201BB139DCA98427.subtitle: Glycerol or propene.
gtia.quest.201BB139DCA98427.desc.0: Glycerol and HCl, or propene, chlorine, hypochlorous acid and sodium hydroxide.
gtia.quest.0900A93101F33F56.title: Epoxy
gtia.quest.0900A93101F33F56.subtitle: Resin for the next boards.
gtia.quest.0900A93101F33F56.desc.0: Epichlorohydrin, bisphenol A and sodium hydroxide in the Large Chemical Reactor.
gtia.quest.447186FB4B1BE503.title: Epoxy Printed Circuit Board
gtia.quest.447186FB4B1BE503.subtitle: The board of nano circuits.
gtia.quest.447186FB4B1BE503.desc.0: The board of the EV nanoprocessors. It points the way out of High Voltage.
gtia.quest.4379D0271D1B261F.title: Ammonia
gtia.quest.4379D0271D1B261F.subtitle: From the Haber-Bosch process.
gtia.quest.4379D0271D1B261F.desc.0: The Haber-Bosch ammonia from Medium Voltage starts the nitrogen line.
gtia.quest.07850D5F99F1D6B3.title: Nitric Oxide
gtia.quest.07850D5F99F1D6B3.subtitle: Burn ammonia.
gtia.quest.07850D5F99F1D6B3.desc.0: Two ammonia and five oxygen give nitric oxide and water.
gtia.quest.45BCA00C70B589B2.title: Nitrogen Dioxide
gtia.quest.45BCA00C70B589B2.subtitle: One more oxygen.
gtia.quest.28BEF3903707AE6F.title: Nitric Acid
gtia.quest.28BEF3903707AE6F.subtitle: The Ostwald absorption tower.
gtia.quest.28BEF3903707AE6F.desc.0: Nitrogen dioxide and water in the Ostwald absorption (Chemical Reactor, circuit 3) give nitric acid; the leftover nitric oxide goes back in.
gtia.quest.78AA6EFC173B7254.title: Dinitrogen Tetroxide
gtia.quest.78AA6EFC173B7254.subtitle: Rocket oxidizer.
gtia.quest.78AA6EFC173B7254.desc.0: Ammonia and oxygen. It burns the rocket fuel.
gtia.quest.6884992211B40BB1.title: Hypochlorous Acid
gtia.quest.6884992211B40BB1.subtitle: Chlorine in water.
gtia.quest.6884992211B40BB1.desc.0: Water and chlorine. It goes into dimethylhydrazine and epichlorohydrin.
gtia.quest.620991D7F7986953.title: Dimethylhydrazine
gtia.quest.620991D7F7986953.subtitle: Needs the HV reactor.
gtia.quest.620991D7F7986953.desc.0: Methanol, ammonia and hypochlorous acid at 480 EU/t.
gtia.quest.6BAC0D9811616319.title: Rocket Fuel
gtia.quest.6BAC0D9811616319.subtitle: Hypergolic.
gtia.quest.6BAC0D9811616319.desc.0: Dimethylhydrazine and dinitrogen tetroxide in the Mixer.
gtia.quest.0D2218E3B2B53113.title: Rocket Parts
gtia.quest.0D2218E3B2B53113.subtitle: Nose cone, fins, tank, engine.
gtia.quest.0D2218E3B2B53113.desc.0: The steel parts of the first rocket.
gtia.quest.2D36D023149FAB9C.title: Rocket Assembler
gtia.quest.2D36D023149FAB9C.subtitle: A launch tower of your own.
gtia.quest.2D36D023149FAB9C.desc.0: A 15 × 15 complex of service towers and stainless scaffolding around the rocket. It builds the &6Tier 1 Rocket&r at 480 EU/t; JEI shows the structure layer by layer.
gtia.quest.26EA3301D33DAFD1.title: Space Suit
gtia.quest.26EA3301D33DAFD1.subtitle: Air to breathe.
gtia.quest.26EA3301D33DAFD1.desc.0: Steel plates, oxygen tanks and wool.
gtia.quest.29B2A2B06F9C3EB9.title: Oxygen Loader
gtia.quest.29B2A2B06F9C3EB9.subtitle: Fill suit and rocket.
gtia.quest.29B2A2B06F9C3EB9.desc.0: It fills the space suit and the rocket with oxygen.
gtia.quest.263C198F162193A8.title: Tier 1 Rocket
gtia.quest.263C198F162193A8.subtitle: The first step off the planet.
gtia.quest.263C198F162193A8.desc.0: Fuel it, climb in and launch.
gtia.quest.5BB3E436D63E796B.title: Launch Pad
gtia.quest.5BB3E436D63E796B.subtitle: Optional: a proper pad.
gtia.quest.5BB3E436D63E796B.desc.0: Place the rocket on a launch pad to launch it.
gtia.quest.2229DE31AC7995F4.title: The Moon
gtia.quest.2229DE31AC7995F4.subtitle: New ores.
gtia.quest.2229DE31AC7995F4.desc.0: Bauxite and ilmenite, sheldonite with platinum, pitchblende, monazite and chromite. On Normal the Moon tears at a body without a tier 1 organ set, so build it before you launch.
gtia.quest.1B5EFA07722DFB20.title: A First Base
gtia.quest.1B5EFA07722DFB20.subtitle: Optional: stay a while.
gtia.quest.1B5EFA07722DFB20.desc.0: Oxygen, power and a place to sleep on the Moon.
gtia.quest.3C9EC5E6195D3A63.title: Lunar Bauxite and Ilmenite
gtia.quest.3C9EC5E6195D3A63.subtitle: The titanium ores.
gtia.quest.3C9EC5E6195D3A63.desc.0: The Moon's bauxite vein carries bauxite, ilmenite and aluminium.
gtia.quest.6D550B622B6C1DE9.title: Rutile
gtia.quest.6D550B622B6C1DE9.subtitle: Titanium dioxide.
gtia.quest.6D550B622B6C1DE9.desc.0: Centrifuge the purified ilmenite or bauxite dust.
gtia.quest.4952D8F20E1BE95C.title: Titanium Tetrachloride
gtia.quest.4952D8F20E1BE95C.subtitle: Chlorinate the rutile.
gtia.quest.4952D8F20E1BE95C.desc.0: Rutile, carbon and chlorine in the Large Chemical Reactor: the Kroll chlorination.
gtia.quest.66699B93A001BA60.title: Magnesium
gtia.quest.66699B93A001BA60.subtitle: The Kroll reductant.
gtia.quest.66699B93A001BA60.desc.0: From talc and soapstone, or from the magnesium chloride the titanium process gives back.
gtia.quest.46339E36EDB132E0.title: Titanium Smelting
gtia.quest.46339E36EDB132E0.subtitle: A strong, light metal.
gtia.quest.46339E36EDB132E0.desc.0: Titanium is a strong and light metal. The Chemical Reactor reduces the tetrachloride with magnesium under argon; the titanium dust melts in the blast furnace and the hot ingots cool in the Vacuum Freezer.
gtia.quest.1A00B390F18BF0CE.title: EV Machine Hull
gtia.quest.1A00B390F18BF0CE.subtitle: The way out of High Voltage.
gtia.quest.1A00B390F18BF0CE.desc.0: Titanium plates, aluminium cables and polyethylene. Extreme Voltage begins.
gtia.quest.5A83D56542A97F8F.title: Platinum
gtia.quest.5A83D56542A97F8F.subtitle: From lunar sheldonite.
gtia.quest.5A83D56542A97F8F.desc.0: Sheldonite gives platinum and palladium. Fine platinum wire goes into the SMD diode.
gtia.quest.46851A114781377E.title: Desh
gtia.quest.46851A114781377E.subtitle: Optional: a preview of EV.
gtia.quest.46851A114781377E.desc.0: A lunar ore for the tier 2 rocket.
gtia.quest.68E6A481B1474EC2.title: Industrial Apiary
gtia.quest.68E6A481B1474EC2.subtitle: Bridge: Bees.
gtia.quest.68E6A481B1474EC2.desc.0: Metal bees and combs start in High Voltage. See the Bees chapter.
gtia.quest.3E17ADB02173B934.title: HV Seed Analyzer
gtia.quest.3E17ADB02173B934.subtitle: Bridge: Agriculture.
gtia.quest.3E17ADB02173B934.desc.0: The HV analyzer and the mutation chamber continue in the Agriculture chapter.
gtia.quest.0F0C544AF45CB0F5.title: Organ Modifier
gtia.quest.0F0C544AF45CB0F5.subtitle: Open yourself up.
gtia.quest.0F0C544AF45CB0F5.desc.0: A voltage coil, two robot arms and MV circuits around a crafting table. Right click it to see your nine organ slots and eight wing slots.
gtia.quest.7F900DC79F2734B3.title: A Body for Space
gtia.quest.7F900DC79F2734B3.subtitle: Nine standard organs.
gtia.quest.7F900DC79F2734B3.desc.0: Every organ comes out of the Assembler from MV parts. The lowest organ sets your &eorgan set tier&r: a full tier 1 set gives +5 armor and lets you survive the Moon and Mars.
gtia.quest.01578DF22BC5B994.title: Steel Wing
gtia.quest.01578DF22BC5B994.subtitle: Fifteen minutes of flight.
gtia.quest.01578DF22BC5B994.desc.0: Put it in a wing slot: it wears down one point per second of flight. Phantom membranes, steel and an LV field generator.
gtia.quest.60788473D81AD7D5.title: Fairy Wing
gtia.quest.60788473D81AD7D5.subtitle: Four hours aloft.
gtia.quest.60788473D81AD7D5.desc.0: Polyethylene foil, stainless steel and an LV field generator: the same flight, sixteen times longer. Wings are used one after the other.
gtia.quest.637A995F8BDDC80B.title: Claus Process
gtia.quest.637A995F8BDDC80B.subtitle: Sulfur from sour gas.
gtia.quest.637A995F8BDDC80B.desc.0: Desulfurizing oil leaves &6Hydrogen Sulfide&r. In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, circuit 5 burns a third of it and reacts the rest over the &6Alumina&r of your Bayer line: sulfur for the Contact process, steam for your boilers. Circuit 6 does the second stage with Sulfur Dioxide.
gtia.quest.5EAA295C6CBB7F46.title: Kroll Process
gtia.quest.5EAA295C6CBB7F46.subtitle: Titanium the real way.
gtia.quest.5EAA295C6CBB7F46.desc.0: The &6Large Chemical Reactor&r chlorinates &6Rutile&r, or the Moon's &6Ilmenite&r, into &6Titanium Tetrachloride&r; the Chemical Reactor then reduces it with &6Magnesium&r under argon (circuit 3). Electrolyze the &6Magnesium Chloride&r to close the loop.
gtia.quest.434EA51BE776FAA7.title: Siemens Process
gtia.quest.434EA51BE776FAA7.subtitle: Silicon, nine nines.
gtia.quest.434EA51BE776FAA7.desc.0: In the &6Chemical Reactor&r, silicon and hydrochloric acid become &6Trichlorosilane&r (circuit 1); on hot rods it deposits &6Polysilicon&r and gives the acid back (circuit 2).
gtia.quest.33BADC8CE603A384.title: Polysilicon
gtia.quest.33BADC8CE603A384.subtitle: Half the silicon per boule.
gtia.quest.33BADC8CE603A384.desc.0: Sixteen of it grow a &6Silicon Boule&r in the Electric Blast Furnace on circuit 3, instead of thirty-two silicon dust.
gtia.quest.50F22493AA07CD18.title: Working in a Cleanroom
gtia.quest.50F22493AA07CD18.subtitle: Some recipes need clean air.
gtia.quest.50F22493AA07CD18.desc.0: Recipes marked &6Cleanroom&r in EMI only run in a machine that stands inside a formed Cleanroom: plascrete walls, filter casings on the ceiling, a door. Bring power and items through the walls with hatches or Diodes.
gtia.quest.50F22493AA07CD18.desc.2: The Cleanroom needs power to stay clean; if it loses it, the recipes inside stop.
gtia.quest.6B85E55F73B1D994.title: Distillation and Cracking
gtia.quest.6B85E55F73B1D994.subtitle: One product per layer.
gtia.quest.6B85E55F73B1D994.desc.0: The Distillation Tower puts one product on each layer, so every layer needs its own Output Hatch. Cracking a fraction first, with Hydrogen or Steam, changes what it splits into.
gtia.quest.058F7C30DAEC3104.title: Catalyst Wear
gtia.quest.058F7C30DAEC3104.subtitle: Normal worlds only.
gtia.quest.058F7C30DAEC3104.desc.0: In &6Normal&r worlds the catalyst of a GTIA chemistry plant has a &e1%&r chance to wear out on every run, so keep a supply line for it. In &6Journey&r worlds catalysts last forever.
gtia.quest.79CCB5BFCA920599.title: Organs Before the Moon
gtia.quest.79CCB5BFCA920599.subtitle: Space hurts.
gtia.quest.79CCB5BFCA920599.desc.0: In &6Normal&r worlds the Moon and Mars hurt a body whose organ set is below tier &e1&r. Fill every organ slot with tier 1 organs before you launch.
gtia.quest.64DD2F37D28FCFCC.title: The Road Ahead
gtia.quest.64DD2F37D28FCFCC.subtitle: More tiers are on their way.
gtia.quest.64DD2F37D28FCFCC.desc.0: You have reached the end of the chapters written so far. Extreme Voltage, space and the larger machines come next.
gtia.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.title: Agriculture
gtia.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.subtitle: Systems: plants that work for you.
gtia.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.desc.2: Agronomica crops grow on &6Crop Sticks&r, cross-breed into new species and drain their soil as they grow. They give fibre, oil, latex and biomass: the raw stuff of rope, fuel, rubber and ethanol.
gtia.quest.15C00FA8C66E0F43.desc.4: This chapter runs next to the tiers. Each quest names the tier it needs, so come back whenever a new machine opens a step.
gtia.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.title: Crop Sticks
gtia.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.subtitle: Four sticks, one farm plot.
gtia.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.desc.0: Till the soil and put &6Crop Sticks&r on the farmland. A seed goes on the sticks, never straight in the ground.
gtia.quest.79D264DC2DF604DE.desc.2: &aSticks on sticks&r make a cross: that is where new plants are born.
gtia.quest.5C6E1876A86071AF.title: Wild Seeds
gtia.quest.5C6E1876A86071AF.subtitle: Grass hides them.
gtia.quest.5C6E1876A86071AF.desc.0: Breaking grass has a &e3%&r chance to drop &6Hemp&r or &6Rapeseed&r seeds. Ten minutes in a meadow is usually enough.
gtia.quest.280C95B44BE970BE.title: Hemp
gtia.quest.280C95B44BE970BE.subtitle: Four stages, then fibre.
gtia.quest.280C95B44BE970BE.desc.0: A ripe plant gives its harvest with a right click and drops back to stage one. &6Hemp Fiber&r becomes string and rope; nobody here will ask what else you thought it was for.
gtia.quest.2CF80B31D06F2D33.title: Rapeseed
gtia.quest.2CF80B31D06F2D33.subtitle: The oil crop.
gtia.quest.2CF80B31D06F2D33.desc.0: Rapeseed gives &6Oily Seeds&r, ten times the oil of a wheat seed. Squeeze them in the Extractor.
gtia.quest.61CDEB8D78DFB807.title: Seed Oil
gtia.quest.61CDEB8D78DFB807.subtitle: Squeezed in the Steam Extractor.
gtia.quest.61CDEB8D78DFB807.desc.0: &e100 mB&r of &6Seed Oil&r per Oily Seed, and the Steam Extractor is enough for it.
gtia.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.title: Oil in the Boiler
gtia.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.subtitle: An early fuel, not a better one.
gtia.quest.690F090EAB32DC94.desc.0: Seed Oil burns in a liquid boiler like Creosote: &e250 mB&r for 17.5 seconds. It is a fuel you can farm instead of dig.
gtia.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.title: Tired Soil
gtia.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.subtitle: Every harvest takes something back.
gtia.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.desc.0: Each plot starts with &e24&r Nitrogen, Phosphorus and Potassium, and each crop eats its own mix. When the soil runs out the plant stops growing.
gtia.quest.6D5D193145CB0911.desc.2: Hand-made fertilisers come from bone meal: with rotten flesh (&6N&r), more bone meal (&6P&r) or charcoal or ash (&6K&r).
gtia.quest.5C0076AE44C3EB29.title: NPK by Hand
gtia.quest.5C0076AE44C3EB29.subtitle: All three in one bag.
gtia.quest.5C0076AE44C3EB29.desc.0: One of each in a crafting grid gives a single &6NPK Fertiliser&r. It works, but the Mixer in MV makes three per batch from real chemistry.
gtia.quest.540A418CDBD31773.title: Compost Barrel
gtia.quest.540A418CDBD31773.subtitle: Scraps in, compost out.
gtia.quest.540A418CDBD31773.desc.0: Dark oak and a slab. Drop plant scraps in the barrel and wait: it slowly turns them into &6Compost&r, the cheap fertiliser of the Greenhouse.
gtia.quest.49E154954764A4ED.title: Compost
gtia.quest.49E154954764A4ED.subtitle: Patience, mostly.
gtia.quest.49E154954764A4ED.desc.0: Collect the &6Compost&r from the barrel. Two of them feed one Greenhouse run.
gtia.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.title: Cross-Breeding
gtia.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.subtitle: Two parents, one surprise.
gtia.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.desc.0: Put a &6cross&r of Crop Sticks between two ripe plants and a child grows there. &6Hemp&r next to &6Rapeseed&r can give &6Elephant Grass&r, whose harvest is the &6Biomass Bundle&r.
gtia.quest.40D5BC0F0055731A.desc.2: The child takes the average of its parents' Growth, Gain and Resistance, give or take a little.
gtia.quest.3387CEA15F0DDD4E.title: Growth, Gain, Resistance
gtia.quest.3387CEA15F0DDD4E.subtitle: Three numbers per seed.
gtia.quest.3387CEA15F0DDD4E.desc.0: &6Growth&r makes the plant faster, &6Gain&r gives more per harvest, &6Resistance&r keeps weeds away. They go from &e1&r to &e31&r; above &e20&r each point is worth less. Breed the best two you have, again and again.
gtia.quest.002D387591CB9B9D.title: Rubber Bush
gtia.quest.002D387591CB9B9D.subtitle: Rapeseed meets Elephant Grass.
gtia.quest.002D387591CB9B9D.desc.0: Cross &6Rapeseed&r with &6Elephant Grass&r for the &6Rubber Bush&r. Its &6Latex&r is rubber that never saw a tree tap.
gtia.quest.4D49C4B1B20C5EC3.title: Vulcanised Rubber
gtia.quest.4D49C4B1B20C5EC3.subtitle: Latex and sulfur, the 1844 way.
gtia.quest.4D49C4B1B20C5EC3.desc.0: Two &6Latex&r and a &6Sulfur Dust&r in the Alloy Smelter give a &6Rubber Bar&r. Dearer than sticky resin, but it grows on a farm.
gtia.quest.5A8DE80B2B95A82C.title: Biomass
gtia.quest.5A8DE80B2B95A82C.subtitle: Grass into fuel.
gtia.quest.5A8DE80B2B95A82C.desc.0: Four &6Biomass Bundles&r and water become &e500 mB&r of &6Biomass&r in the Brewery. Ferment it again for ethanol; the High Voltage bees drink it too.
gtia.quest.56013617611B005C.title: Seed Analyzer
gtia.quest.56013617611B005C.subtitle: Know what you are breeding.
gtia.quest.56013617611B005C.desc.0: Reads the Growth, Gain and Resistance of a seed so you breed on purpose instead of by hope. Higher tiers analyse faster.
gtia.quest.6AE53EA8632C0F32.title: Industrial NPK
gtia.quest.6AE53EA8632C0F32.subtitle: Ammonia, phosphate, potash.
gtia.quest.6AE53EA8632C0F32.desc.0: Urea from &6Ammonia&r and &6Carbon Dioxide&r, monoammonium phosphate from &6Phosphoric Acid&r and &6Ammonia&r, potassium chloride from &6Rock Salt&r. The Mixer turns one of each into &e3&r NPK, worth &e35&r of every nutrient.
gtia.quest.113F593262989A47.title: Greenhouse
gtia.quest.113F593262989A47.subtitle: Hundreds of plants, one block entity.
gtia.quest.113F593262989A47.desc.0: The GTNA &6Greenhouse&r needs open sky above its glass roof: dim light slows it. One seed of the crop stays in the input bus as a catalyst; &e1&r NPK and &e1,000 mB&r of water give &e8&r of its harvest every 30 seconds. Compost works too, &e2&r per run for &e6&r.
gtia.quest.4C222A05EE2D18AE.title: Harvest by the Stack
gtia.quest.4C222A05EE2D18AE.subtitle: No more clicking.
gtia.quest.4C222A05EE2D18AE.desc.0: A stack of fibre without a single right click. Feed the Greenhouse from the Mixer and the barrels, and its output into the Brewery.
gtia.quest.72AB8F349180CB28.title: HV Seed Analyzer
gtia.quest.72AB8F349180CB28.subtitle: Faster reading.
gtia.quest.72AB8F349180CB28.desc.0: The same reading in a fraction of the time, for breeding programs that never stop.
gtia.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.title: Bees
gtia.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.subtitle: Systems: metal that buzzes.
gtia.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.desc.0: No hives grow in the wild here and no bee works for free. A bee goes into a cage, the cage goes into a machine, and the machine makes combs that turn into ore.
gtia.quest.534EA0EFEFEF196A.desc.2: Everything in this chapter runs on High Voltage. The rarer species wait for Extreme Voltage.
gtia.quest.41BEC28E3DE99535.title: Bee Cage
gtia.quest.41BEC28E3DE99535.subtitle: Steel rods and iron bars.
gtia.quest.41BEC28E3DE99535.desc.0: Four &6Steel Rods&r and four &6Iron Bars&r make two cages. Right-click a bee with an empty cage to catch it.
gtia.quest.219D196510C59DB9.title: A Bee in a Cage
gtia.quest.219D196510C59DB9.subtitle: The vanilla kind will do.
gtia.quest.219D196510C59DB9.desc.0: Ordinary bees still live in &6Bee Nests&r on oak and birch trees near flowers. Catch one: every metal species starts from a wild bee.
gtia.quest.57A6FBE224B5D911.title: Honey Bottle
gtia.quest.57A6FBE224B5D911.subtitle: From the same nests.
gtia.quest.57A6FBE224B5D911.desc.0: A glass bottle on a full nest. Calm the bees with a campfire under it first.
gtia.quest.2C61BAEEE679316E.title: Biomass for Bees
gtia.quest.2C61BAEEE679316E.subtitle: Breakfast.
gtia.quest.2C61BAEEE679316E.desc.0: &e1,000 mB&r of &6Biomass&r per new bee. The Brewery makes it from plants; Elephant Grass from the Agriculture chapter is the best feed.
gtia.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.title: Metal Bee
gtia.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.subtitle: Four blocks of metal and a lot of biomass.
gtia.quest.7B40B3F427F9CA07.desc.0: In an HV &6Chemical Reactor&r: a caged wild bee, &e4&r blocks of the metal and &e1,000 mB&r of Biomass give a caged metal bee.
gtia.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.title: Industrial Apiary
gtia.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.subtitle: A hive with a power cable.
gtia.quest.6C8989C00FB54110.desc.0: The caged bee sits in the input as a catalyst and is never used up. With &e100 mB&r of water it makes &e2&r combs every &e20&r seconds at HV, faster with overclocks.
gtia.quest.1D7DEEAD4BE44447.title: Metal Comb
gtia.quest.1D7DEEAD4BE44447.subtitle: Ore that grew.
gtia.quest.1D7DEEAD4BE44447.desc.0: Each species makes its own comb. Two ways to open it, one of them much better.
gtia.quest.1136E33E3FD99DE1.title: The Lazy Way
gtia.quest.1136E33E3FD99DE1.subtitle: Centrifuge: one small pile.
gtia.quest.1136E33E3FD99DE1.desc.0: A &6Centrifuge&r turns a comb into a single &6Small Dust&r. It works, and it wastes three quarters of the comb.
gtia.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.title: Comb Leaching
gtia.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.subtitle: Four combs, four purified ores.
gtia.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.desc.0: &e4&r combs and &e384 mB&r of &6Hydrochloric Acid&r in the Chemical Reactor give &e4&r &6Purified Ore&r of the metal, straight into your ore line with all its byproducts. This is how GTNH bees pay for themselves.
gtia.quest.21AD28D820DFECB8.desc.2: &o&7Zinc has no ore in GregTech, so zinc combs only go through the Centrifuge.&r
gtia.quest.0283F4777ECE4253.title: Honey Treat
gtia.quest.0283F4777ECE4253.subtitle: Bribes for the Mutation Chamber.
gtia.quest.0283F4777ECE4253.desc.0: A &6Honey Bottle&r, two &6Wheat&r and &6Sugar&r in the Mixer give &e4&r treats and the bottle back.
gtia.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.title: Mutation Chamber
gtia.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.subtitle: No luck, only recipes.
gtia.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.desc.0: Two caged parents (kept), a caged wild bee, &e4&r Honey Treats and &e2&r blocks of the metal give the new species every time. No random rolls.
gtia.quest.4D5FE0F95AD07F5E.desc.2: &o&7The chamber is HV; the species it makes need Extreme Voltage power.&r
gtia.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.title: Species of Extreme Voltage
gtia.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.subtitle: Five more, one tier later.
gtia.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.desc.0: &6Titanium&r = Iron + Aluminium · &6Tungsten&r = Titanium + Tin · &6Molybdenum&r = Copper + Lead · &6Redstone&r = Copper + Gold · &6Lapis&r = Aluminium + Silver.
gtia.quest.3D8102E26BB79B9D.desc.2: Their chamber run, their apiary and their combs all need EV power.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.title: Power Generation
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.subtitle: Every way to make EU, side by side.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.desc.0: Read this chapter as a table. Each row is an era of the game and opens when you reach that era's chapter. Each column is one way of making energy.
gtia.quest.44A46278A3F8D21A.desc.2: Across a row: what you can build right now, and how the options compare. Down a column: how one family grows. The cards on top list each generator's fuels with the EU one bucket gives, taken from this pack's recipes.
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.title: Steam Era
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.subtitle: Before the first circuit.
gtia.quest.59BFC8519082F00F.desc.0: Steam is your only energy at first, and the &6Primitive Steam Turbine&r turns some of it into Ultra Low Voltage power.
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.title: Low Voltage
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.subtitle: 32 V.
gtia.quest.2A3ACA2C3D46971B.desc.0: Low Voltage machines take up to &e32 V&r. Every column has something to offer here; pick by the fuel you can make in quantity.
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.title: Medium Voltage
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.subtitle: 128 V.
gtia.quest.67603F6319B6BE99.desc.0: Medium Voltage machines take up to &e128 V&r. Feed them with generators of this row, or step up power from a lower row with a &6Transformer&r.
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.title: High Voltage
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.subtitle: 512 V.
gtia.quest.561B52AF01F909B0.desc.0: High Voltage machines take up to &e512 V&r. This is where the large multiblock turbines start to pay off.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.title: What Steam Turbines Burn
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.subtitle: Steam, and nothing else.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.desc.0: Turbines eat the steam of the column to their left. A boiler that keeps up with them is the real limit.
gtia.quest.6825BD9BBB0C7299.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.title: What Combustion Burns
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.subtitle: Liquid fuels, best first.
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.0: Combustion Generators burn liquid fuels. The cheapest ones, &6Ethanol&r and &6Biodiesel&r, need no oil at all.
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.245DCFF675F471FD.desc.15: ...and 3 more; the recipe viewer lists them all.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.title: What Gas Turbines Burn
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.subtitle: Gases, best first.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.0: Gas Turbines burn gases and light hydrocarbons. Several of them come out of the same distillation that makes combustion fuel, so the two columns grow together.
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.2: EU per bucket, from the recipes in this pack:
gtia.quest.6888AA3D8B43F8F1.desc.15: ...and 6 more; the recipe viewer lists them all.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.title: Steam Sources
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.subtitle: Boilers feed the steam column.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.desc.0: Boilers burn fuel and turn &6Water&r into &6Steam&r. They make no EU themselves: the turbines of the next column do.
gtia.quest.57C8F6D2AFFC13D0.desc.2: &aCount your boilers first. A turbine is only as good as the steam behind it.&r
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.title: Solar Steam
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.subtitle: No fuel, only daylight.
gtia.quest.1856DF81C57045AD.desc.0: Solar boilers heat water with the sun. &aNo fuel at all&r, but &cnothing at night&r, and little steam per block. They help a boiler line; they rarely replace it.
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.title: Multiblock Generators
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.subtitle: When one block is not enough.
gtia.quest.29385E8F8A503528.desc.0: Multiblock generators burn the same fuels as the columns to their left, in larger amounts. Their output depends on the &ddynamo hatch&r you give them, and turbines also on their &drotor&r.
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.title: Small Boiler
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.subtitle: Coal, Coke, anything that burns.
gtia.quest.3AAA180E09437A9E.desc.0: The first steam source. Its high-pressure Steel version makes more steam from the same fuel.
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.title: Solar Boiler
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.subtitle: Free steam under the sun.
gtia.quest.6BCC9A6A869B0CEE.desc.0: No fuel at all: the sun heats the water. It needs Glass, so it comes after the Block mold. It makes little steam and none at night, so it helps a boiler rather than replacing it.
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.title: Large Bronze Boiler
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.subtitle: A multiblock steam source.
gtia.quest.7E7DA01CE9FCB06D.desc.0: The first multiblock boiler. Its controller asks for circuits, which is why it sits in this row and not the one above.
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.title: Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.subtitle: Your boilers, now at 32 V.
gtia.quest.43074C8C716C9325.desc.0: The easiest LV generator: you already make the steam. Its card above shows how much steam one EU costs, so count your boilers before you count your turbines.
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.title: High-Pressure Solar Boiler
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.subtitle: Steel catches more sun.
gtia.quest.02BD89F42EEA3A2F.desc.0: The Steel solar boiler makes more steam than the bronze one, still only in daylight.
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.title: Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.subtitle: Liquid fuel at 32 V.
gtia.quest.3F0AF891DBF5592B.desc.0: Burns the fuels of the card above. &6Ethanol&r from the &6Fermenter&r is the one you can make without oil.
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.title: Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.subtitle: Gas at 32 V.
gtia.quest.54E397E3A3102798.desc.0: Burns the gases of the card above. &6Ethylene&r from ethanol dehydration is one of them.
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.title: Large Steel Boiler
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.subtitle: More steam per block.
gtia.quest.7E1D8EFB2FDE7648.desc.0: The Steel multiblock boiler: four HV circuits, so it comes at the end of MV. Pair it with Large Steam Turbines or a wall of singleblock turbines.
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.title: MV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.subtitle: Same steam, higher voltage.
gtia.quest.450D882E5F3A898F.desc.0: Burns steam faster to put out &e128 V&r. Steam stays a fine choice as long as your boilers keep up.
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.title: MV Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.subtitle: Time to refine oil.
gtia.quest.05DA28115DE19755.desc.0: At this voltage the better fuels of the card start to matter: &6Light Fuel&r, &6Diesel&r and &6Gasoline&r come from oil.
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.title: MV Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.subtitle: Refinery gases.
gtia.quest.4CB01F660D55F64D.desc.0: Oil refining leaves gases behind; this turbine turns them into &e128 V&r instead of waste.
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.title: HV Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.subtitle: The last singleblock steam turbine.
gtia.quest.376D75A1D2CBA365.desc.0: &e512 V&r from steam. Beyond this, steam power continues only as a multiblock.
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.title: HV Combustion Generator
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.subtitle: 512 V from liquid fuel.
gtia.quest.1512A8817E04B678.desc.0: Burns the same fuels faster. A steady &6Diesel&r or &6Gasoline&r line keeps it fed.
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.title: HV Gas Turbine
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.subtitle: 512 V from gas.
gtia.quest.399AB73AFD2C5FF3.desc.0: The last singleblock gas turbine. &6Benzene&r is among the best fuels on its card.
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.title: Large Steam Turbine
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.subtitle: Rotors and a dynamo hatch.
gtia.quest.454E7912C2206322.desc.0: A multiblock turbine: its output depends on the rotor you put in its holder and on the dynamo hatch it feeds. The rotor wears out and has to be replaced.
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.title: Ethanol
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.subtitle: Fuel from plants.
gtia.quest.0DC1DE34C1447B26.desc.0: Carry a bucket of &6Ethanol&r from your Fermenter. It is the combustion fuel you can make from plants alone.
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.title: Ethylene
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.subtitle: Ethanol, one step further.
gtia.quest.5B3CD6418743CBCD.desc.0: Carry a bucket of &6Ethylene&r from the Chemical Reactor's dehydration. Burn it in a Gas Turbine, or keep it: it is also the base of plastics later on.
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.title: Cables
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.subtitle: Every cable has a limit.
gtia.quest.362BC27422A49172.desc.0: A cable has a voltage limit and an amperage limit, and loses a little energy per block. Too much of either and it burns.
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.title: Battery Buffer
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.subtitle: Store what you do not use yet.
gtia.quest.7DE3FF6591EB9D2C.desc.0: A &6Battery Buffer&r holds batteries and evens out the difference between what your generators make and what your machines draw.
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.title: Transformer
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.subtitle: Move power between rows.
gtia.quest.1475602FFABD8D61.desc.0: A &6Transformer&r steps voltage up or down by one tier. It is how a row of cheap generators feeds the machines of the next row.
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.title: Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.subtitle: How multiblocks take power.
gtia.quest.3B2E5EB89E167E4B.desc.0: Multiblocks take power through &6Energy Hatches&r. Its voltage coil comes out of an electric Assembler. The hatch's tier decides the voltage the whole machine runs at.
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.title: Generator Array
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.subtitle: Any column, many at once.
gtia.quest.0E180AC8A31597FD.desc.0: GTNA's &6Generator Array&r takes singleblock steam turbines, combustion generators or gas turbines and runs them inside one multiblock. Any one of the three columns opens it.
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.title: Wireless Networks
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.subtitle: Steam and electricity without pipes or cables.
gtia.quest.5C019B5E2846B9D4.desc.0: GTNA moves steam and electricity through the air. Steam hatches share steam over a wireless network. Electricity goes through the Nexus Flux Matrix: generators deposit energy into it and machines draw energy from it.
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.title: Wireless Steam Output Hatch
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.subtitle: Send steam into the network.
gtia.quest.66FE9D53EFC5809F.desc.0: Put the output hatch next to a boiler and its steam goes into the wireless network instead of into pipes.
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.title: Wireless Steam Input Hatch
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.subtitle: Draw steam from the network.
gtia.quest.3AEF99284092055C.desc.0: Put the input hatch on a steam machine and it draws the steam it needs from the network.
gtia.quest.51A80DE0F5320E35.title: Steam Manufacturer
gtia.quest.51A80DE0F5320E35.subtitle: Hydraulic assembly.
gtia.quest.51A80DE0F5320E35.desc.0: The Steam Manufacturer assembles hydraulic parts and upgrades steam hatches. It runs on steam alone, 16 per parallel, whatever the recipe says.
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.title: Steel Wireless Steam Hatches
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.subtitle: More capacity.
gtia.quest.51BA7FA5C93FFC0A.desc.0: The Steel versions of the wireless steam hatches hold far more steam than the Bronze ones, which matters once you run several large machines.
gtia.quest.28B3E457A1246B30.title: MV Bender
gtia.quest.28B3E457A1246B30.subtitle: Dense plates.
gtia.quest.28B3E457A1246B30.desc.0: The Flux Matrix is built from dense steel plates, and only an MV Bender presses nine plates into one.
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.title: Nexus Flux Matrix
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.subtitle: A wireless battery for the factory.
gtia.quest.2696A2F1B3139C12.desc.0: The Nexus Flux Matrix is a large multiblock that stores EU and shares it wirelessly. Fill its interior with Nexus Capacitors: more and better capacitors mean more storage.
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.title: Nexus Capacitor
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.subtitle: Storage for the matrix.
gtia.quest.62B6515FA46E9E07.desc.0: Nexus Capacitors fill the interior of the Flux Matrix. The basic one stores 160,000 EU; higher tiers store far more.
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.title: Nexus Linker
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.subtitle: Tie a hatch to the matrix.
gtia.quest.5BDAE697615BCBC7.desc.0: The Nexus Linker connects hatches to the Flux Matrix. Shift-click the matrix controller, then click the hatch you want to link.
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.title: Wireless Dynamo Hatch
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.subtitle: Deposit energy into the matrix.
gtia.quest.6B4A626EEB7C8149.desc.0: Put a Wireless Dynamo Hatch on a generator and link it with the Nexus Linker: the generator deposits its energy into the Flux Matrix.
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.title: Wireless Energy Hatch
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.subtitle: Draw energy from the matrix.
gtia.quest.37121221C77746A4.desc.0: Put a Wireless Energy Hatch on a machine and link it with the Nexus Linker: the machine draws power from the Flux Matrix with no cable at all.
gtia.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.title: Multiblock Goals
gtia.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.subtitle: Every multiblock of the pack.
gtia.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.desc.0: A tracker of every multiblock in the pack, the way the GTNH book keeps its Multiblock Goals. Many of them can be built earlier than their row says if you find the parts; check back often.
gtia.quest.4ACCC233513F88B0.desc.2: Rows go down by tier and open with the machine hull of that tier. Columns, left to right: Steam and Bricks, Furnaces and Metals, Chemistry, Ores and Mining, Processing and Assembly, Power, Farming and Life, Storage and Data, Space, Wonders and Oddities.

gtia.quest.1C80807B0037B387.title: How to Read the Book
gtia.quest.1C80807B0037B387.subtitle: A central route with useful side branches.
gtia.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.0: In the Start chapter the road is the main route: it runs right, turns down, runs back left and turns again. Connected side quests offer supplies, convenience features and preparation for later machines.
gtia.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.2: A line points from a prerequisite to the quest it unlocks. A quest with several prerequisites needs all of them. The information quests in this chapter can be read right away.
gtia.quest.1C80807B0037B387.desc.4: Checkmark tasks are manual acknowledgements. Item tasks require the pictured items; rewards must be claimed separately. Convenience commands are optional and only run when you claim their rewards.
gtia.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.title: Before You Begin
gtia.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.subtitle: A safe workshop and a few useful controls.
gtia.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.0: Set up a safe place for your workshop, with storage, lighting and room to expand. Keep water and a renewable supply of wood close by.
gtia.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.2: Check your Controls menu for conflicting key bindings, especially the quest book, recipe browser and map. These mods share many keys by default.
gtia.quest.4EB24270ABDDBEB7.desc.4: Item tasks in this chapter detect items in your inventory without consuming them. Collecting a Creosote Bucket also uses normal inventory detection.
gtia.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.title: About the Pack
gtia.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.subtitle: Your materials, machines and progression.
gtia.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.0: GTCEu Modern provides the foundation of the factory. GTIACore and GregTech Nexus Addon add the materials, machines and larger systems used by Infinity Ascension.
gtia.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.2: The campaign follows Start, Steam, LV and the higher voltage tiers. This chapter prepares your first workshop; it does not require electricity.
gtia.quest.13B25D31A4A94152.desc.4: The item and recipe browser is your reference for exact ingredients and machine recipes. Search an item and open its recipes or uses whenever a quest introduces something new.
gtia.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.title: Welcome to Infinity Ascension
gtia.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.subtitle: From a small workshop to an infinite factory.
gtia.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.0: Welcome to GregTech Infinity Ascension! Your journey begins with a workbench, a furnace and a handful of ores, then grows into a factory powered by steam and electricity.
gtia.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.2: In the Start chapter, follow the road from left to right and down. Side branches introduce useful supplies, tools and building aids. Open a quest to read its instructions; hover over a task or reward to see the item it uses.
gtia.quest.48ED4F35ECCFD529.desc.4: Check this task and claim your Starting Kit next to it; the tools in it depend on your world's mode.
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.title: Room for a Factory
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.subtitle: Building supplies for a growing workshop.
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.0: Your factory will need more space than a small shelter. Plan a flat work area with room for storage, machines, pipes and future expansions.
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.2: Claim the Platform Builder, Industrial Platform and construction supplies. Use the Construction Wand and its Angel Core to help place blocks; check their tooltips and key bindings before building.
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.4: The Personal Space portal opens your own dimension: an empty, flat world (configurable: void, superflat, layers) where you can build the factory without terrain in the way. Place it, then right-click it to set the dimension up.
gtia.quest.290D8F8D57B5FA44.desc.6: This is an optional building kit. Take the space to plan your workshop, then acknowledge the task to collect it.
gtia.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.title: Freeze Daylight
gtia.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.subtitle: Keep the world at its current time of day.
gtia.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.desc.0: Optional world setting. Claiming this reward disables the daylight cycle and freezes the current time of day; it does not set the time to noon.
gtia.quest.79F9D0A994CF9EDB.desc.2: This changes the whole world, including other players. To restore the cycle, an operator can run /gamerule doDaylightCycle true. The quest can be repeated if you need to apply it again.
gtia.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.title: Freeze Weather
gtia.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.subtitle: Keep the current weather from changing.
gtia.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.desc.0: Optional world setting. Claiming this reward disables the weather cycle and keeps the current weather. It does not clear rain that is already falling.
gtia.quest.4B0F76331F09E588.desc.2: This changes the whole world, including other players. To restore normal weather changes, an operator can run /gamerule doWeatherCycle true. The quest can be repeated.
gtia.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.title: Night Vision
gtia.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.subtitle: Light up your view of the underground.
gtia.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.desc.0: Optional personal convenience. Claim the reward to receive Night Vision with an infinite duration, making caves and unlit areas easier to see.
gtia.quest.75F8535E4B2326CE.desc.2: The effect is applied to the player claiming the reward. Milk, death or another effect-removal mechanic can remove it; repeat this quest to apply it again. Night Vision does not stop hostile mobs from spawning.
gtia.quest.1E3D206AD1480630.title: GTIA Rules
gtia.quest.1E3D206AD1480630.subtitle: What your world's mode changes.
gtia.quest.1E3D206AD1480630.desc.0: Type &6/gtia rules&r to see every rule of this world: recipe speed and cost, steam, maintenance, tools, ore veins, survival and the rest, each with its Journey and Normal value.
gtia.quest.1E3D206AD1480630.desc.2: The rules are fixed when the world is made. A few of them are read when the game starts, so a new world with other values asks you to restart first.
gtia.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.title: Community and Wiki
gtia.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.subtitle: Questions, bugs and ideas.
gtia.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.desc.0: The pack's Discord is &6discord.gg/TW5vugknk5&r: questions, bug reports and playtesting.
gtia.quest.4C58C4CD61D5370D.desc.2: The developer docs (GitHub: GTInfinityAscension/GTIA-Dev-Doc) explain the tiers, the systems and every design decision.
gtia.quest.76593A77A7CEB2F3.title: Off to Work
gtia.quest.76593A77A7CEB2F3.subtitle: The Start chapter is next.
gtia.quest.76593A77A7CEB2F3.desc.0: That is everything you need to know before the first tree. The Start chapter takes you from a log to your first Coke, one step at a time.
gtia.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.title: Finding Recipes (EMI)
gtia.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.subtitle: R for recipes, U for uses.
gtia.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.desc.0: Hover over any item and press &6R&r to see how it is made or &6U&r to see what it is used in. &6A&r adds it to your favourites on the left.
gtia.quest.097B60D5955D7CF7.desc.2: In a recipe, the &6+&r button fills the crafting grid from your inventory. On a multiblock controller, the first tab shows the whole structure, layer by layer.
gtia.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.title: Crafting Chain
gtia.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.subtitle: Every step of a recipe at once.
gtia.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.desc.0: Crafting Chain crafts an item &6and every intermediate step&r with one key, from what is in your inventory and the chests next to a Crafting Station. When something is missing it says exactly what.
gtia.quest.1F33FD31AC3A4F22.desc.2: Check its key in Controls; it starts unbound if another mod already uses it.
gtia.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.title: Maps and Claims
gtia.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.subtitle: Find your way back.
gtia.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.desc.0: The minimap in the corner and the full map (&6M&r) are Xaero's. Add a waypoint at your base and at every ore vein you find.
gtia.quest.79C83BFB96453D45.desc.2: On a server, claim your base with FTB Chunks from the map so nobody breaks it, and force-load the chunks your machines need to keep running.
gtia.quest.781C717CA1C571FD.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.781C717CA1C571FD.subtitle: Journey kit.
gtia.quest.781C717CA1C571FD.desc.0: Journey worlds start strong: these are the tools the author picked.
gtia.quest.4AB61B15543297E5.title: Starting Kit
gtia.quest.4AB61B15543297E5.subtitle: Normal kit.
gtia.quest.4AB61B15543297E5.desc.0: Normal worlds get tools of the age: steel, built to last the Steam Age.
gtia.quest.584AA28B1CB94C4A.title: Journey World
gtia.quest.584AA28B1CB94C4A.subtitle: A gentler pace.
gtia.quest.584AA28B1CB94C4A.desc.0: This world is &6Journey&r. Same quests, same machines, kinder numbers: recipes are faster and cheaper, boilers give more steam, machines need no maintenance, vanilla recipes are simpler, you keep your inventory on death and radioactive materials do not hurt.
gtia.quest.584AA28B1CB94C4A.desc.2: &a/gtia rules&r lists every rule and its value. The mode is fixed when the world is made.
gtia.quest.4840C870BDD00959.title: Normal World
gtia.quest.4840C870BDD00959.subtitle: The pack as designed.
gtia.quest.4840C870BDD00959.desc.0: This world is &6Normal&r: the full pack, with the numbers it was balanced for. Maintenance, material hazards, catalyst wear and the organ requirements of other planets are all on.
gtia.quest.4840C870BDD00959.desc.2: &a/gtia rules&r lists every rule and its value. The mode is fixed when the world is made.
